AI.conclusion: 该分类法和实验审计为评估和追踪AI同行评审的可靠性提供了循证基线，并指出了需要针对性、可测试缓解措施的具体失效点。

title: LLMs Reading the Rhythms of Daily Life: Aligned Understanding for Behavior Prediction and Generation
summary:
Human daily behavior unfolds as complex sequences shaped by intentions, preferences, and context. Effectively modeling these behaviors is crucial for intelligent systems such as personal assistants and recommendation engines. While recent advances in deep learning and behavior pre-training have improved behavior prediction, key challenges remain--particularly in handling long-tail behaviors, enhancing interpretability, and supporting multiple tasks within a unified framework. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising direction due to their semantic richness, strong interpretability, and generative capabilities. However, the structural and modal differences between behavioral data and natural language limit the direct applicability of LLMs.
  To address this gap, we propose Behavior Understanding Alignment (BUA), a novel framework that integrates LLMs into human behavior modeling through a structured curriculum learning process. BUA employs sequence embeddings from pretrained behavior models as alignment anchors and guides the LLM through a three-stage curriculum, while a multi-round dialogue setting introduces prediction and generation capabilities. Experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate that BUA significantly outperforms existing methods in both tasks, highlighting its effectiveness and flexibility in applying LLMs to complex human behavior modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Behavior Understanding Alignment (BUA)框架，通过结构化课程学习将大语言模型(LLMs)与行为序列数据对齐，在多个真实数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有行为预测方法在处理长尾行为、可解释性和多任务统一框架方面存在不足，而LLMs虽有语义丰富和生成能力强等优势，但行为数据与自然语言在结构和模态上存在差异，难以直接应用。
AI.method: BUA框架利用预训练行为模型的序列嵌入作为对齐锚点，通过三阶段课程学习引导LLM理解行为数据，并采用多轮对话设置引入预测和生成能力。
AI.result: 在两个真实数据集上的实验表明，BUA在多项任务中显著优于现有方法，验证了其有效性和灵活性。
AI.conclusion: BUA框架成功弥合了行为数据与自然语言之间的鸿沟，为LLMs在复杂人类行为建模中的应用提供了行之有效的方案。

title: Probing Visual Planning in Image Editing Models
comment: Accepted to ES-Reasoning Workshop @ ICLR 2026. Our code is available at https://github.com/spatigen/amaze
summary: Visual planning represents a crucial facet of human intelligence, especially in tasks that require complex spatial reasoning and navigation. Yet, in machine learning, this inherently visual problem is often tackled through a verbal-centric lens. While recent research demonstrates the promise of fully visual approaches, they suffer from significant computational inefficiency due to the step-by-step planning-by-generation paradigm. In this work, we present EAR, an editing-as-reasoning paradigm that reformulates visual planning as a single-step image transformation. To isolate intrinsic reasoning from visual recognition, we employ abstract puzzles as probing tasks and introduce AMAZE, a procedurally generated dataset that features the classical Maze and Queen problems, covering distinct, complementary forms of visual planning. The abstract nature of AMAZE also facilitates automatic evaluation of autoregressive and diffusion-based models in terms of both pixel-wise fidelity and logical validity. We assess leading proprietary and open-source editing models. The results show that they all struggle in the zero-shot setting, finetuning on basic scales enables remarkable generalization to larger in-domain scales and out-of-domain scales and geometries. However, our best model that runs on high-end hardware fails to match the zero-shot efficiency of human solvers, highlighting a persistent gap in neural visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EAR（编辑即推理）范式，将视觉规划任务重构为单步图像变换，并引入AMAZE数据集（含迷宫和皇后问题）进行测试。研究发现现有编辑模型在零样本设置下表现不佳，但基础微调可泛化到更复杂场景，尽管最佳模型仍未能达到人类求解器的效率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉规划方法多采用逐步生成范式，计算效率低下；且视觉规划问题常被当作语言问题来处理，未能充分利用视觉模态的优势。作者希望提出更高效的视觉推理范式。
AI.method: 提出EAR（Editing-as-Reasoning）范式，将多步视觉规划转化为单步图像编辑/变换任务。同时构建AMAZE数据集，包含迷宫问题和皇后问题两种抽象谜题，用于隔离内在推理与视觉识别能力，支持自动评估。
AI.result: 现有闭源和开源的编辑模型在零样本设置下均表现困难；在基础尺度上微调后，模型能够显著泛化到更大的域内尺度和域外尺度及几何形状。但最佳模型在高端硬件上仍无法匹配人类求解器的零样本效率。
AI.conclusion: EAR范式展示了将视觉规划简化为单步编辑的可行性，但神经视觉推理与人类智能之间仍存在显著差距，表明该领域需进一步研究。

title: ComplianceNLP: Knowledge-Graph-Augmented RAG for Multi-Framework Regulatory Gap Detection
comment: Accepted at ACL 2026 Industry Track. 19 pages, 15 tables, 1 figure
summary: Financial institutions must track over 60,000 regulatory events annually, overwhelming manual compliance teams; the industry has paid over USD 300 billion in fines and settlements since the 2008 financial crisis. We present ComplianceNLP, an end-to-end system that automatically monitors regulatory changes, extracts structured obligations, and identifies compliance gaps against institutional policies. The system integrates three components: (1) a knowledge-graph-augmented RAG pipeline grounding generations in a regulatory knowledge graph of 12,847 provisions across SEC, MiFID II, and Basel III; (2) multi-task obligation extraction combining NER, deontic classification, and cross-reference resolution over a shared LEGAL-BERT encoder; and (3) compliance gap analysis that maps obligations to internal policies with severity-aware scoring. On our benchmark, ComplianceNLP achieves 87.7 F1 on gap detection, outperforming GPT-4o+RAG by +3.5 F1, with 94.2% grounding accuracy ($r=0.83$ vs. human judgments) and 83.4 F1 under realistic end-to-end error propagation. Ablations show that knowledge-graph re-ranking contributes the largest marginal gain (+4.6 F1), confirming that structural regulatory knowledge is critical for cross-reference-heavy tasks. Domain-specific knowledge distillation (70B $\to$ 8B) combined with Medusa speculative decoding yields $2.8\times$ inference speedup; regulatory text's low entropy ($H=2.31$ bits vs. $3.87$ general text) produces 91.3% draft-token acceptance rates. In four months of parallel-run deployment processing 9,847 updates at a financial institution, the system achieved 96.0% estimated recall and 90.7% precision, with a $3.1\times$ sustained analyst efficiency gain. We report deployment lessons on trust calibration, GRC integration, and distributional shift monitoring for regulated-domain NLP.

AI.tldr: 提出ComplianceNLP系统，通过知识图谱增强RAG、多任务义务提取和合规差距分析，在金融机构监管合规场景中实现87.7 F1的差距检测性能，并带来3.1倍分析师效率提升。
AI.motivation: 金融机构每年需追踪超过6万件监管事件，手动合规团队不堪重负，自2008年金融危机以来行业已支付超过3000亿美元的罚款和和解金，亟需自动化合规系统。
AI.method: 集成三个组件：(1) 知识图谱增强的RAG管道，基于包含12,847条规定的监管知识图谱；(2) 多任务义务提取，结合NER、道义分类和交叉引用解析，共享LEGAL-BERT编码器；(3) 合规差距分析，将义务映射到内部政策并进行严重性感知评分。采用领域知识蒸馏（70B→8B）和Medusa推测解码实现加速。
AI.result: 差距检测F1达87.7，超过GPT-4o+RAG 3.5个点；接地准确率94.2%；端到端错误传播下F1为83.4；知识图谱重排贡献最大边际增益（+4.6 F1）；推理速度提升2.8倍；实际部署四个月处理9,847条更新，召回率96.0%、精确率90.7%，分析师效率提升3.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的监管知识对交叉引用密集型任务至关重要，领域知识蒸馏在保持性能的同时大幅提升推理速度，并分享了信任校准、GRC集成和分布漂移监测等部署经验。

title: Tandem: Riding Together with Large and Small Language Models for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have catalyzed the rise of reasoning-intensive inference paradigms, where models perform explicit step-by-step reasoning before generating final answers. While such approaches improve answer quality and interpretability, they incur substantial computational overhead due to the prolonged generation sequences. In this paper, we propose Tandem, a novel collaborative framework that synergizes large and small language models (LLMs and SLMs) to achieve high-quality reasoning with significantly reduced computational cost. Specifically, the LLM serves as a strategic coordinator, efficiently generating a compact set of critical reasoning insights. These insights are then used to guide a smaller, more efficient SLM in executing the full reasoning process and delivering the final response. To balance efficiency and reliability, Tandem introduces a cost-aware termination mechanism that adaptively determines when sufficient reasoning guidance has been accumulated, enabling early stopping of the LLM's generation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that Tandem reduces computational costs by approximately 40% compared to standalone LLM reasoning, while achieving superior or competitive performance. Furthermore, the sufficiency classifier trained on one domain transfers effectively to others without retraining. The code is available at: https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ACL2026_Tandem.

AI.tldr: Tandem提出了一种大模型（LLM）与小模型（SLM）协同推理框架：LLM仅生成少量关键推理线索，SLM据此完成完整推理，并引入成本感知终止机制，在保证性能的同时降低约40%计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM逐步推理虽然提升了质量和可解释性，但生成长序列导致计算成本过高，亟需兼顾推理质量与效率的新型范式。
AI.method: 构建LLM与SLM协同框架：LLM作为策略协调者生成精简关键推理线索，SLM基于这些线索执行完整推理过程；同时设计成本感知终止机制，自适应地决定何时停止LLM生成以平衡效率与可靠性。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上，相比单独使用LLM推理，计算成本降低约40%，性能达到甚至超越原有水平；且充分性分类器可在不同领域间零迁移。
AI.conclusion: Tandem通过大模型"点拨"、小模型"执行"的协作模式，有效降低了推理计算开销，为高效推理提供了一种可行的范式。

title: SketchVLM: Vision language models can annotate images to explain thoughts and guide users
summary: When answering questions about images, humans naturally point, label, and draw to explain their reasoning. In contrast, modern vision-language models (VLMs) such as Gemini-3-Pro and GPT-5 only respond with text, which can be difficult for users to verify. We present SketchVLM, a training-free, model-agnostic framework that enables VLMs to produce non-destructive, editable SVG overlays on the input image to visually explain their answers. Across seven benchmarks spanning visual reasoning (maze navigation, ball-drop trajectory prediction, and object counting) and drawing (part labeling, connecting-the-dots, and drawing shapes around objects), SketchVLM improves visual reasoning task accuracy by up to +28.5 percentage points and annotation quality by up to 1.48x relative to image-editing and fine-tuned sketching baselines, while also producing annotations that are more faithful to the model's stated answer. We find that single-turn generation already achieves strong accuracy and annotation quality, and multi-turn generation opens up further opportunities for human-AI collaboration. An interactive demo and code are at https://sketchvlm.github.io/.

AI.tldr: SketchVLM是一个无需训练、模型无关的框架，能让视觉语言模型在图像上生成可编辑的SVG覆盖图来视觉化解释其答案，在多项基准测试中提升了准确率和标注质量。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM仅以文本形式回答问题，用户难以验证其推理过程，而人类在回答图像问题时天然会使用指向、标注和绘图等方式来解释推理。
AI.method: 提出SketchVLM框架，无需训练、模型无关，在输入图像上生成非破坏性、可编辑的SVG覆盖图，支持单轮和多轮生成。
AI.result: 在7个基准测试上，视觉推理任务准确率提升最多+28.5个百分点，标注质量提升最高1.48倍，且生成的标注更忠实于模型给出的答案。
AI.conclusion: 单轮生成已能达到较强的准确率和标注质量，多轮生成则为人机协作提供了更多可能性。

title: Causal Discovery as Dialectical Aggregation: A Quantitative Argumentation Framework
comment: Accepted at the 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KR 2026). This arXiv version includes supplementary material and additional implementation details
summary: Constraint-based causal discovery is brittle in finite-sample regimes because erroneous conditional-independence (CI) decisions can cascade into substantial structural errors. We propose Quantitative Argumentation for Causal Discovery (QACD), a semantics-driven framework that represents CI outcomes as graded, defeasible arguments rather than irreversible constraints. QACD maps statistical test outcomes to argument strengths and aggregates conflicting evidence through connectivity-mediated witness propagation, producing a fixed-point acceptability labeling over candidate adjacencies. Experiments on standard benchmark Bayesian networks suggest that QACD improves structural coherence and interventional reliability in several noisy or inconsistent CI regimes, while remaining competitive with classical constraint-based, hybrid, and prior argumentation-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出QACD框架，用可分级、可废止的论证替代传统条件独立性约束，通过传播机制聚合冲突证据，在噪声条件下提升因果结构学习鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于约束的因果发现方法在有限样本下脆弱，因为条件独立性决策错误会级联导致严重结构错误。
AI.method: 将统计检验结果映射为论证强度，通过连通性介导的证人传播聚合冲突证据，得到候选邻接的可接受性固定点标签。
AI.result: 在标准贝叶斯网络基准上，QACD在噪声或不一致CI情景下改善了结构连贯性和干预可靠性，与经典基线方法竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: QACD通过论证语义框架有效缓解了约束级联错误问题，在有限样本下的因果发现中具有优势。

title: Structural Enforcement of Goal Integrity in AI Agents via Separation-of-Powers Architecture
summary: Recent evidence suggests that frontier AI systems can exhibit agentic misalignment, generating and executing harmful actions derived from internally constructed goals, even without explicit user requests. Existing mitigation methods, such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and constitutional prompting, operate primarily at the model level and provide only probabilistic safety guarantees. We propose the Policy-Execution-Authorization (PEA) architecture, a "separation-of-powers" design that enforces safety at the system level. PEA decouples intent generation, authorization, and execution into independent, isolated layers connected via cryptographically constrained capability tokens. We present five core contributions: (C1) an Intent Verification Layer (IVL) for ensuring capability-intent consistency; (C2) Intent Lineage Tracking (ILT), which binds all executable intents to the originating user request via cryptographic anchors; (C3) Goal Drift Detection, which rejects semantically divergent intents below a configurable threshold; (C4) an Output Semantic Gate (OSG) that detects implicit coercion using a structured $K \times I \times P$ threat calculus (Knowledge, Influence, Policy); and (C5) a formal verification framework proving that goal integrity is maintained even under adversarial model compromise. By shifting agent alignment from a behavioral property to a structurally enforced system constraint, PEA provides a robust foundation for the governance of autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PEA架构，通过分离意图生成、授权与执行三个独立层，并引入加密能力令牌、意图溯源追踪、目标漂移检测、输出语义门控和形式化验证等机制，将AI智能体的安全性从行为层面提升为系统级结构约束。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如RLHF、宪法提示）仅在模型层面提供概率性安全保证，无法有效应对前沿AI系统可能出现的"能动性失调"——即系统自主构建并执行有害目标，即便没有用户明确请求。
AI.method: 提出PEA架构，基于"权力分离"原则，将系统解耦为意图生成、授权与执行三个独立层，通过加密能力令牌实现层间通信；具体包括五个核心组件：意图验证层、意图溯源追踪、目标漂移检测、输出语义门控（基于K×I×P威胁演算）以及形式化验证框架。
AI.result: 通过形式化验证证明，即使在模型被对抗性攻击的情况下，系统仍能保持目标完整性。
AI.conclusion: PEA将智能体对齐从行为属性转变为结构性强制的系统约束，为自主智能体的治理提供了鲁棒的基础。

title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Truly Understand Small Objects?
comment: Under Peer Review (26 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables)
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising potential in diverse understanding tasks, e.g., image and video analysis, math and physics olympiads. However, they remain blank and unexplored for Small Object Understanding (SOU) tasks. To fill this gap, we introduce SOUBench, the first and comprehensive benchmark for exploring the small objects understanding capability of existing MLLMs. Specifically, we first design an effective and automatic visual question-answer generation strategy, constructing a new SOU-VQA evaluation dataset, with 18,204 VQA pairs, six relevant sub-tasks, and three dominant scenarios (i.e., Driving, Aerial, and Underwater). Then, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation on 15 state-of-the-art MLLMs and reveal their weak capabilities in small object understanding. Furthermore, we develop SOU-Train, a multimodal training dataset with 11,226 VQA pairs, to improve the SOU capabilities of MLLMs. Through supervising fine-tuning of the latest MLLM, we demonstrate that SOU-Train can effectively enhance the latest MLLM's ability to understand small objects. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that, the proposed SOUBench, along with the SOU-VQA and SOU-Train datasets, provides a crucial empirical foundation to the community for further developing models with enhanced small object understanding capabilities. Datasets and Code: https://github.com/Hanfj-X/SOU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SOUBench，第一个针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）小物体理解能力的综合基准，包含18,204个VQA对、6个子任务和3个场景。评估15个MLLMs发现其小物体理解能力薄弱，并构建SOU-Train训练数据集以提升该能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在图像视频分析、数学物理等领域表现优异，但在小物体理解（SOU）任务上仍是空白，缺乏专门的评估基准。
AI.method: 设计自动视觉问答生成策略构建SOU-VQA评估数据集（18,204对，6个子任务，3个场景）；评估15个SOTA MLLMs；构建SOU-Train训练数据集（11,226对）并对最新MLLM进行监督微调。
AI.result: 15个SOTA MLLMs在小物体理解上能力薄弱；SOU-Train微调能有效提升最新MLLM的小物体理解能力。
AI.conclusion: SOUBench及配套数据集为社区提升MLLMs小物体理解能力提供了关键的实证基础。

title: GraphPlanner: Graph Memory-Augmented Agentic Routing for Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: LLM routing has achieved promising results in integrating the strengths of diverse models while balancing efficiency and performance. However, to support more realistic and challenging applications, routing must extend into agentic LLM settings, where task planning, multi-round cooperation among heterogeneous agents, and memory utilization are indispensable. To address this gap, we propose GraphPlanner, a heterogeneous graph memory-augmented agentic router for multi-agent LLMs that generates routing workflows for each query and supports both inductive and transductive inference. GraphPlanner formulates workflow generation as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), where at each step it selects both the LLM backbone and the agent role, including Planner, Executor, and Summarizer. By leveraging a heterogeneous graph, denoted as GARNet, to capture interaction memories among queries, agents, and responses, GraphPlanner integrates historical memory and workflow memory into richer state representations. The entire pipeline is optimized with reinforcement learning, jointly improving task-specific performance and computational efficiency. We evaluate GraphPlanner across 14 diverse LLM tasks and demonstrate that: (1) GraphPlanner outperforms strong single-round and multi-round routers, improving accuracy by up to 9.3% while reducing GPU cost from 186.26 GiB to 1.04 GiB; (2) GraphPlanner generalizes robustly to unseen tasks and LLMs, exhibiting strong zero-shot capabilities; and (3) GraphPlanner effectively leverages historical memories, supporting both inductive and transductive inference for more adaptive routing. Our code for GraphPlanner is released at https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/GraphPlanner.

AI.tldr: GraphPlanner是一种基于异构图记忆增强的多智能体LLM路由框架，通过将工作流生成建模为马尔可夫决策过程，利用异构图GARNet捕捉查询、智能体和响应之间的交互记忆，联合优化任务性能和计算效率，在14项任务上准确率提升最高达9.3%，GPU成本从186.26 GiB降至1.04 GiB。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM路由方法主要针对单轮设置，无法支持需要任务规划、多轮智能体协作和记忆利用的复杂智能体场景，因此需要一种能够扩展到多智能体LLM环境中的路由机制。
AI.method: 将工作流生成建模为马尔可夫决策过程，每步选择LLM主干和智能体角色（规划器、执行器、汇总器）；利用异构图GARNet捕获查询、智能体和响应间的交互记忆，将历史记忆和工作流记忆融入状态表示；采用强化学习联合优化任务性能和计算效率，支持归纳和转导推理。
AI.result: 在14个多样化LLM任务上，GraphPlanner相比强基线准确率提升最高9.3%，GPU成本从186.26 GiB降至1.04 GiB；对未见任务和LLM展现出强零样本能力；有效利用历史记忆，支持归纳和转导推理实现更自适应路由。
AI.conclusion: GraphPlanner成功将路由扩展到多智能体LLM场景，通过异构图记忆增强和强化学习优化，在性能和效率上均取得显著提升，并且具有良好的泛化能力和自适应特性。

title: Federated Cross-Modal Retrieval with Missing Modalities via Semantic Routing and Adapter Personalization
summary: Federated cross-modal retrieval faces severe challenges from heterogeneous client data, particularly non-IID semantic distributions and missing modalities. Under such heterogeneity, a single global model is often insufficient to capture both shared cross-modal knowledge and client-specific characteristics. We propose RCSR, a personalization-friendly federated framework that integrates prototype anchoring, retrieval-centric semantic routing, and optional client-specific adapters. Built on a frozen CLIP backbone, RCSR leverages lightweight shared adapters for global knowledge transfer while supporting efficient local personalization. Prototype anchoring helps unimodal clients align with global cross-modal semantics, and a server-side semantic router adaptively assigns aggregation weights based on retrieval consistency to mitigate alignment drift during heterogeneous updates. Extensive experiments on MS-COCO, Flickr30K, and other benchmarks show that RCSR consistently improves global retrieval accuracy and training stability, while further enhancing client-level retrieval performance, especially for clients with incomplete modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/RezinChow/RCSR-Retrieval-Centric-Semantic-Routing.

AI.tldr: 提出RCSR联邦框架，通过原型锚定、检索中心语义路由和客户端适配器，解决异构数据下的跨模态检索问题，在多个基准上提升检索准确率与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 联邦跨模态检索面临客户端数据异构（非IID语义分布、模态缺失）的严峻挑战，单一全局模型无法同时捕捉共享跨模态知识和客户端特定特征。
AI.method: 基于冻结CLIP骨干，RCSR集成轻量共享适配器用于全局知识迁移，原型锚定帮助单模态客户端对齐全局跨模态语义，服务端语义路由器根据检索一致性自适应分配聚合权重。
AI.result: 在MS-COCO、Flickr30K等基准上，RCSR一致提升全局检索准确率和训练稳定性，并进一步增强客户端级检索性能，尤其对模态不完整的客户端效果显著。
AI.conclusion: RCSR有效缓解了联邦异构建模问题，兼顾全局共享知识与局部个性化需求，代码已开源。

title: Transferable Human Mobility Network Reconstruction with neuroGravity
summary: Accurate modeling of human mobility is critical for tackling urban planning and public health challenges. In undeveloped regions, the absence of comprehensive travel surveys necessitates reconstructing mobility networks from publicly available data. Here we develop neuroGravity, a physics-informed deep learning model that reliably reconstructs mobility flows from limited observations and transfers to unobserved cities. Using only urban facility and population distributions, we find that neuroGravity's regional representations strongly correlate with socioeconomic and livability status, offering scalable proxies for costly surveys. Furthermore, we uncover that spatial income segregation plays a key role in model transferability: mobility networks are most reliably reconstructed when target cities share similar segregation levels with the source. We design an index to quantify this segregation and accurately predict transferability. Finally, we generate mobility flow proxies for over 1,200 cities worldwide, highlighting neuroGravity's potential to mitigate critical data shortages in resource-limited, underdeveloped areas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经引力模型（neuroGravity），一种物理启发的深度学习模型，能从有限观测数据和公开的城市设施、人口分布中可靠重建人类移动网络，并迁移到未观测城市，为资源匮乏地区提供移动性数据代理。
AI.motivation: 在欠发达地区缺乏全面的出行调查数据，无法准确建模人类移动性，亟需从公开可用数据中重建移动网络的方法。
AI.method: 提出神经引力模型（neuroGravity），一种物理启发的深度学习模型，利用城市设施和人口分布数据重建移动流，并实现跨城市迁移。
AI.result: 模型区域表示与 socioeconomic 和宜居性状态强相关；空间收入隔离是影响模型可迁移性的关键因素，设计了隔离指数准确预测迁移性；为全球1200多个城市生成了移动流代理数据。
AI.conclusion: 神经引力模型能有效缓解资源受限欠发达地区的移动数据短缺问题，为城市规划与公共卫生研究提供可扩展的解决方案。

title: Neural Grammatical Error Correction for Romanian
summary: Resources for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) in non-English languages are scarce, while available spellcheckers in these languages are mostly limited to simple corrections and rules. In this paper we introduce a first GEC corpus for Romanian consisting of 10k pairs of sentences. In addition, the German version of ERRANT (ERRor ANnotation Toolkit) scorer was adapted for Romanian to analyze this corpus and extract edits needed for evaluation. Multiple neural models were experimented, together with pretraining strategies, which proved effective for GEC in low-resource settings. Our baseline consists of a small Transformer model trained only on the GEC dataset (F0.5 of 44.38), whereas the best performing model is produced by pretraining a larger Transformer model on artificially generated data, followed by finetuning on the actual corpus (F0.5 of 53.76). The proposed method for generating additional training examples is easily extensible and can be applied to any language, as it requires only a POS tagger

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个罗马尼亚语语法错误纠正(GEC)语料库，包含1万对句子，并通过预训练策略在低资源环境下实现了F0.5达53.76的最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 非英语语言的语法错误纠正资源匮乏，现有的拼写检查器大多局限于简单的修正和规则，缺乏针对罗马尼亚语的GEC数据集和评估工具。
AI.method: 构建了10k句对的罗马尼亚语GEC语料库，适配了ERRANT评分工具，实验了多种神经模型与预训练策略，采用在人工生成数据上预训练再在真实语料上微调的方法。
AI.result: 基线小Transformer模型F0.5为44.38，最佳模型（更大Transformer+预训练+微调）F0.5达到53.76。
AI.conclusion: 提出的通过人工生成数据预训练的方法有效且易于扩展到其他语言，仅需一个词性标注器即可。

title: Breaking Degradation Coupling: A Structural Entropy Guided Decoupled Framework and Benchmark for Infrared Enhancement
summary: Thermal infrared image enhancement aims to restore high-quality images from complex compound degradations. Existing all-in-one approaches typically employ a single shared backbone to handle diverse degradations, which causes gradient interference and parameter competition. To address this, we propose a Structural Entropy-Guided Decoupled (SEGD) Framework. Unlike unified modeling paradigms, SEGD decomposes compound degradations into independent sub-processes and models them in a divide-and-conquer manner through Degradation-Specific Residual Modules (DRMs). Each DRM focuses on residual estimation for a specific degradation, enabling task decoupling while remaining jointly trainable, which mitigates parameter contention. A Degradation-Aware Evidential Network further estimates degradation type and intensity, providing priors that adaptively regulate DRM restoration strength. To handle compound cases, DRMs are composed in varying orders to form multiple restoration paths, from which the most informative features are aggregated under a structural-entropy criterion, yielding decoder-ready representations with structural fidelity and degradation awareness. Integrating divide-and-conquer restoration, evidential perception, and entropy-guided adaptation, SEGD achieves fine-grained and interpretable enhancement. We also construct a nighttime TIR benchmark for evaluation under real low-light conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that SEGD surpasses state-of-the-art methods while achieving higher efficiency with fewer parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出结构熵引导的解耦框架（SEGD），将热红外图像中的复合退化分解为独立子过程，通过退化特定残差模块（DRM）分治处理，结合退化感知证据网络和结构熵准则进行特征聚合，实现高效且可解释的图像增强。
AI.motivation: 现有一体化方法使用单一共享骨干网络处理多种退化，导致梯度干扰和参数竞争问题，需要更精细的解耦方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出结构熵引导的解耦框架（SEGD）；2) 使用退化特定残差模块（DRM）独立处理各类退化；3) 引入退化感知证据网络估计退化类型与强度；4) 基于结构熵准则选择最优恢复路径进行特征聚合。
AI.result: 超越现有最先进方法，且参数更少、效率更高；同时构建了夜间热红外基准数据集用于真实低光照条件评估。
AI.conclusion: 分治恢复、证据感知与熵引导自适应相结合的策略能实现细粒度且可解释的热红外图像增强。

title: Information-Theoretic Measures in AI: A Practical Decision Guide
comment: 25 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. Submitted to Applied Intelligence (Springer)
summary:
Information-theoretic (IT) measures are ubiquitous in artificial intelligence: entropy drives decision-tree splits and uncertainty quantification, cross-entropy is the default classification loss, mutual information underpins representation learning and feature selection, and transfer entropy reveals directed influence in dynamical systems.
  A second, less consolidated family of measures, integrated information (Phi), effective information (EI), and autonomy, has emerged for characterizing agent complexity. Despite wide adoption, measure selection is often decoupled from estimator assumptions, failure modes, and safe inferential claims.
  This paper provides a practical decision framework for all seven measures, organized around three prescriptive questions for each: (i) what question does the measure answer and in which AI context; (ii) which estimator is appropriate for the data type and dimensionality; and (iii) what is the most dangerous misuse. The framework is operationalized in two complementary artifacts: a measure-selection flowchart and a master decision table. We cover both AI/ML and decision-making agent application domains per measure, with standardized Bridge Boxes linking IT quantities to cognitive constructs. Three worked examples illustrate the framework on concrete practitioner scenarios spanning representation learning, temporal influence analysis, and evolved agent complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对七种信息论度量（熵、交叉熵、互信息、转移熵、整合信息、有效信息和自主性），提出了一个实用的决策框架，围绕三个核心问题：度量回答什么问题、选择何种估计器、最危险的误用是什么，并提供了流程图和决策表两种工具。
AI.motivation: 信息论度量在AI中广泛应用，但度量选择常与估计器假设、失败模式和推理安全性脱节，缺乏系统性的决策指导。
AI.method: 围绕每种度量的三个核心问题（回答什么问题、适合何种估计器、最危险的误用）构建决策框架，通过流程图和决策表形式呈现，并用三个实例演示。
AI.result: 提出了包含七种度量的决策框架，涵盖AI/ML和决策智能体两个应用领域，标准化了信息论与认知概念的桥接。
AI.conclusion: 该框架帮助从业者在不同场景下合理选择和使用信息论度量，避免常见的误用和推断陷阱。

title: Benchmarking Testing in Automated Theorem Proving
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in formal theorem proving, yet evaluating semantic correctness remains challenging. Existing evaluations rely on indirect proxies such as lexical overlap with human-annotated proof, or expensive manual inspection. Inspired by the shift from lexical comparison to test-based evaluation in code generation, we propose T , a framework that evaluates the semantic correctness of formal theorems: a generated theorem is considered correct only if all dependent successor theorems compile successfully, analogous to integration testing. We construct a benchmark from 5 real-world Lean 4 repositories, comprising 2,206 problems paired with 41 successor theorems on average, automatically extracted without human effort. Experiments demonstrate that while state-of-the-art models achieve high compilation success, they perform significantly worse under our semantic metric. The best model, Claude-Sonnet-4.5, achieves only 38.9% Testing Accuracy on the full set, given both natural language proof and successor theorems as context, revealing a critical gap in current theorem generation capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为T的框架，通过检查生成定理的所有依赖后续定理是否成功编译来评估形式定理的语义正确性，类似代码生成中的集成测试。实验表明，现有最先进模型在该语义指标下表现显著较差，最佳模型Claude-Sonnet-4.5仅达38.9%的测试准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有形式定理证明评估依赖间接指标（如词汇重叠或人工检查），无法准确评估语义正确性。
AI.method: 提出T框架：生成定理正确仅当所有依赖的后续定理编译成功（类似集成测试）；从5个真实Lean 4代码库自动构建基准数据集（2,206个问题，平均41个后续定理）。
AI.result: 最佳模型Claude-Sonnet-4.5在完整数据集上测试准确率仅38.9%，远低于其编译成功率。
AI.conclusion: 当前定理生成能力存在关键差距，现有模型在语义正确性评估下表现远不如预期。

title: Text-Guided Multimodal Unified Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection based on RGB-3D multimodal data has emerged as a mainstream paradigm for intelligent quality inspection. However, existing unsupervised methods suffer from two critical limitations: ambiguous cross-modal alignment caused by the lack of high-level semantic guidance and insufficient geometric modeling for RGB-to-3D feature mapping. To address these issues, we propose a unified multimodal industrial anomaly detection framework guided by text semantics. The framework consists of two core modules: a Geometry-Aware Cross-Modal Mapper to preserve geometric structure during modality conversion, and an Object-Conditioned Textual Feature Adaptor to align multimodal features with semantic priors. Furthermore, we establish a unified learning paradigm for multimodal industrial anomaly detection, which breaks the one-model-one-class constraint and enables accurate anomaly detection across diverse classes using a single model. Extensive experiments on the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in classification and localization under unsupervised settings.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于文本语义引导的RGB-3D多模态工业异常检测统一框架，通过几何感知跨模态映射器和对象条件文本特征适配器，解决现有方法中跨模态对齐模糊和几何建模不足的问题，实现单模型多类别的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督RGB-3D多模态工业异常检测方法存在两个关键局限：一是缺乏高层语义引导导致跨模态对齐模糊，二是RGB到3D特征映射的几何建模不足。
AI.method: 提出统一多模态工业异常检测框架，包含两个核心模块：几何感知跨模态映射器（保留模态转换中的几何结构）和对象条件文本特征适配器（将多模态特征与语义先验对齐），并建立了统一学习范式以打破单模型单类别限制。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上，该方法在无监督设置下的分类和定位任务中均达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的文本语义引导的多模态框架有效解决了跨模态对齐和几何建模问题，实现了单模型多类别的精准异常检测。

title: Expert Evaluation of LLM's Open-Ended Legal Reasoning on the Japanese Bar Exam Writing Task
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on legal benchmarks, including multiple-choice components of bar exams. However, their capacity for generating open-ended legal reasoning in realistic scenarios remains insufficiently explored. Notably, to our best knowledge, there are no prior studies or datasets addressing this issue in the Japanese context.
  This study presents the first dataset designed to evaluate the open-ended legal reasoning performance of LLMs within the Japanese jurisdiction. The dataset is based on the writing component of the Japanese bar examination, which requires examinees to identify multiple legal issues from long narratives and to construct structured legal arguments in free text format. Our key contribution is the manual evaluation of LLMs' generated responses by legal experts, which reveals limitations and challenges in legal reasoning. Moreover, we conducted a manual analysis of hallucinations to characterize when and how the models introduce content not supported by precedent or law.
  Our real exam questions, model-generated responses, and expert evaluations reveal the milestones of current LLMs in the Japanese legal domain. Our dataset and relevant resources will be available online.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次构建了基于日本司法考试写作部分的开放式法律推理数据集，并通过法律专家人工评估揭示了当前LLM在法律推理中存在的局限性与幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有法律基准（如选择题型bar exam）已显示LLM的较强表现，但LLM在真实场景下的开放式法律推理能力尚未被充分探索，尤其在日语法律语境中缺乏相关研究与数据集。
AI.method: 构建基于日本司法考试写作部分的数据集，要求LLM从长篇叙述中识别多个法律问题并生成结构化法律论证；由法律专家对模型输出进行人工评估，并对幻觉现象进行手动分析。
AI.result: 通过真实考题、模型生成回答及专家评估，揭示了当前LLM在日本法律领域的里程碑式表现，同时指出了其在法律推理中的局限性与幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在开放式法律推理任务中仍存在明显不足，尤其容易产生缺乏判例或法律依据支持的幻觉内容；本数据集及相关资源将公开，以推动该方向的研究。

title: Agri-CPJ: A Training-Free Explainable Framework for Agricultural Pest Diagnosis Using Caption-Prompt-Judge and LLM-as-a-Judge
comment: This work is an expanded version of our prior paper published in the IEEE ICASSP 2026 conference arXiv:2512.24947, from 4 to 20+ pages, presenting a well-structured and principled framework, extensive experiments, and deeper insights. Tao Fang is the corresponding author
summary: Crop disease diagnosis from field photographs faces two recurring problems: models that score well on benchmarks frequently hallucinate species names, and when predictions are correct, the reasoning behind them is typically inaccessible to the practitioner. This paper describes Agri-CPJ (Caption-Prompt-Judge), a training-free few-shot framework in which a large vision-language model first generates a structured morphological caption, iteratively refined through multi-dimensional quality gating, before any diagnostic question is answered. Two candidate responses are then generated from complementary viewpoints, and an LLM judge selects the stronger one based on domain-specific criteria. Caption refinement is the component with the largest individual impact: ablations confirm that skipping it consistently degrades downstream accuracy across both models tested. On CDDMBench, pairing GPT-5-Nano with GPT-5-mini-generated captions yields \textbf{+22.7} pp in disease classification and \textbf{+19.5} points in QA score over no-caption baselines. Evaluated without modification on AgMMU-MCQs, GPT-5-Nano reached 77.84\% and Qwen-VL-Chat reached 64.54\%, placing them at or above most open-source models of comparable scale despite the format shift from open-ended to multiple-choice. The structured caption and judge rationale together constitute a readable audit trail: a practitioner who disagrees with a diagnosis can identify the specific caption observation that was incorrect. Code and data are publicly available https://github.com/CPJ-Agricultural/CPJ-Agricultural-Diagnosis

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agri-CPJ（Caption-Prompt-Judge），一种无需训练的小样本框架，通过结构化形态描述生成、多维度质量门控迭代优化、双视角候选回答及LLM裁判机制，显著提升作物病害诊断的准确性和可解释性，在CDDMBench上疾病分类提升22.7个百分点，QA得分提升19.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有作物病害诊断模型存在两个核心问题：一是模型在基准测试中表现良好但经常幻觉作物物种名称；二是即使预测正确，其推理过程通常对从业者不可见、不可理解。
AI.method: Agri-CPJ是一个无需训练的小样本框架，包含三个步骤：1）大视觉语言模型先生成结构化形态描述，通过多维度质量门控进行迭代优化；2）从互补视角生成两个候选回答；3）LLM裁判基于领域特定标准选择更优的回答。
AI.result: 在CDDMBench上，GPT-5-Nano搭配GPT-5-mini生成的描述，疾病分类提升22.7个百分点，QA得分提升19.5个百分点。在AgMMU-MCQs上，GPT-5-Nano达77.84%，Qwen-VL-Chat达64.54%，达到或超过同等规模大多数开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 结构化描述生成是影响最大的组件，消融实验证实跳过它会持续降低下游准确性。生成的描述和裁判推理共同构成可读的审计轨迹，从业者若不同意诊断结果，可识别出具体哪条描述观察有误。

title: Modeling Induced Pleasure through Cognitive Appraisal Prediction via Multimodal Fusion
summary: Multimodal affective computing analyzes user-generated social media content to predict emotional states. However, a critical gap remains in understanding how visual content shapes cognitive interpretations and elicits specific affective experiences such as pleasure. This study introduces a novel computational model to infer video-induced pleasure via cognitive appraisal variables. The proposed model addresses four challenges: (1) noisy and inconsistent human labels, (2) the semantic gap between "positive emotions" and "pleasure," (3) the scarcity of pleasure-specific datasets, and (4) the limited interpretability of existing black-box fusion methods. Our approach integrates data-driven and cognitive theory-driven methods, using cognitive appraisal theory and a fuzzy model within an innovative framework. The model employs transformer-based architectures and attention mechanisms for fine-grained multimodal feature extraction and interpretable fusion to capture both inter- and intra-modal dynamics associated with pleasure. This enables the prediction of underlying appraisal variables, thereby bridging the semantic gap and enhancing model explainability beyond conventional statistical associations. Experimental results validate the efficacy of the proposed method in detecting video-induced pleasure, achieving a peak accuracy of 0.6624 in predicting pleasure levels. These findings highlight promising implications for affective content recommendation, intelligent media creation, and advancing our understanding of how digital media influences human emotions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合认知评价理论与模糊模型的计算框架，用于推断视频引发的愉悦情绪，通过Transformer架构和注意力机制实现多模态特征提取与可解释融合，在愉悦预测任务上达到0.6624的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感计算缺乏对视觉内容如何塑造认知解释并引发特定情感体验（如愉悦）的深入理解，存在标签噪声、语义鸿沟、数据集稀缺和黑盒融合方法可解释性差等问题。
AI.method: 结合数据驱动与认知理论驱动方法，采用认知评价理论和模糊模型，使用Transformer架构和注意力机制进行细粒度多模态特征提取与可解释融合，捕捉模态内和模态间的愉悦相关动态，预测潜在的评价变量。
AI.result: 实验验证了该方法在检测视频诱发愉悦方面的有效性，愉悦水平预测的最高准确率达到0.6624。
AI.conclusion: 研究成果对情感内容推荐、智能媒体创作以及理解数字媒体如何影响人类情感具有重要启示意义。

title: Multimodal QUD: Inquisitive Questions from Scientific Figures
summary: Asking inquisitive questions while reading, and looking for their answers, is an important part in human discourse comprehension, curiosity, and creative ideation, and prior work has investigated this in text-only scenarios. However, in scientific or research papers, many of the critical takeaways are conveyed through both figures and the text that analyzes them. While scientific visualizations have been used to evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) capabilities, current benchmarks are limited to questions that focus simply on extracting information from them. Such questions only require lower-level reasoning, do not take into account the context in which a figure appears, and do not reflect the communicative goals the authors wish to achieve. We generate inquisitive questions that reach the depth of questions humans generate when engaging with scientific papers, conditioned on both the figure and the paper's context, and require reasoning across both modalities. To do so, we extend the linguistic theory of Questions Under Discussion (QUD) from being text-only to multimodal, where implicit questions are raised and resolved as discourse progresses. We present MQUD, a dataset of research papers in which such questions are made explicit and annotated by the original authors. We show that fine-tuning a VLM on MQUD shifts the model from generating generic low-level visual questions to content-specific grounding that requires a high-level of multimodal reasoning, yielding higher-quality, more visually grounded multimodal QUD generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态QUD框架，将语言学的"讨论中问题"理论扩展到图文结合场景，构建MQUD数据集（由原作者标注），并通过微调VLM生成更高质量、跨模态推理的探究性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有科学图表基准仅测试低层次信息提取，缺乏考虑图表在论文上下文中的沟通目标，无法模拟人类阅读时提出的深层探究性问题。
AI.method: 1) 将QUD理论从纯文本扩展到多模态；2) 构建MQUD数据集，由原作者标注隐含的探究性问题；3) 在MQUD上微调VLM，使其从生成通用低级问题转向生成内容特异性、高层次跨模态推理问题。
AI.result: 微调后的VLM能够生成更高质量、更视觉化、更具备多模态推理能力的QUD，相比基线模型有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 多模态QUD框架有效提升了VLM在图-文联合理解中的深层推理能力，为评估和增强VLMs的科学阅读理解提供了新范式。

title: AnemiaVision: Non-Invasive Anemia Detection via Smartphone Imagery Using EfficientNet-B3 with TrivialAugmentWide, Mixup Augmentation, and Persistent Patient History Management
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Final year personal project, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Indian Institute of Information Technology Surat. Code: https://github.com/RAHULPATEL2002/anemia-detection Demo: https://anemia-detection-gbmj.onrender.com
summary: Anemia affects over one billion people globally and remains severely under-diagnosed in low-resource regions where laboratory blood tests are inaccessible. This paper presents AnemiaVision, an end-to-end web-based system for non-invasive anemia screening from smartphone photographs of the palpebral conjunctiva and fingernail beds. The proposed pipeline fine-tunes a pre-trained EfficientNet-B3 backbone with a redesigned three-layer classifier head incorporating BatchNorm, GELU activations, and high-rate Dropout (0.45/0.35). Training employs four orthogonal accuracy-boosting techniques: TrivialAugmentWide for policy-free image augmentation, RandomErasing for spatial regularisation, Mixup (alpha=0.2) for inter-class smoothing, and cosine-annealing scheduling with linear warmup. Early stopping is governed by peak validation accuracy rather than validation loss to prevent premature termination on high-variance epochs. The deployed Flask application integrates persistent patient-history management backed by PostgreSQL on Render, with an automated database-migration entrypoint ensuring zero data loss across redeploys. Ablation experiments demonstrate that accuracy-first early stopping contributes +1.6% and Mixup contributes +2.8% to final validation accuracy. Overall, the proposed system achieves a validation accuracy of 96.2% and AUC-ROC of 0.98, compared with 44.9% validation accuracy and AUC-ROC of 0.58 from the three-epoch CPU-only baseline. Sensitivity for the anemic class reaches 0.96, making the system suitable as a first-line screening tool for community health workers in rural settings. The system is publicly accessible and source code is openly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnemiaVision——一种基于智能手机照片（眼睑结膜和指甲床）的非侵入性贫血筛查系统，使用微调EfficientNet-B3和多项训练优化技术，在验证集上达到96.2%准确率和0.98 AUC-ROC，可作为低资源地区一线筛查工具。
AI.motivation: 全球超10亿人受贫血影响，但在低资源地区因实验室血液检测不可及而严重漏诊，亟需一种非侵入性、低成本且可部署的筛查方案。
AI.method: 微调EfficientNet-B3骨干网络，重新设计三层分类头（含BatchNorm、GELU激活和高丢弃率Dropout）；采用TrivialAugmentWide、RandomErasing、Mixup（alpha=0.2）和余弦退火+线性预热四种正交增强技术；以验证准确率峰值而非损失值作为早停准则；构建Flask应用+PostgreSQL持久化患者管理。
AI.result: 验证准确率96.2%，AUC-ROC 0.98，贫血类别灵敏度0.96；消融实验显示准确率优先早停提升1.6%、Mixup提升2.8%；相比CPU三周期基线（44.9%准确率、0.58 AUC-ROC）显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该系统适合作为农村社区健康工作者的一线筛查工具，且已公开源代码和在线访问。

title: Domain-Filtered Knowledge Graphs from Sparse Autoencoder Features
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) extract millions of interpretable features from a language model, but flat feature inventories aren't very useful on their own. Domain concepts get mixed with generic and weakly grounded features, while related ideas are scattered across many units, and there's no way to understand relationships between features. We address this by first constructing a strict domain-specific concept universe from a large SAE inventory using contrastive activations and a multi-stage filtering process. Next, we build two aligned graph views on the filtered set: a co-occurrence graph for corpus-level conceptual structure, organized at multiple levels of granularity, and a transcoder-based mechanism graph that links source-layer and target-layer features through sparse latent pathways. Automated edge labeling then turns these graph views into readable knowledge graphs rather than unlabeled layouts. In a case study on a biology textbook, these graphs recover coherent chapter and subchapter-level structure, reveal concepts that bridge neighboring topics, and transform messy sentence-level activity containing thousands of features into compact, readable views that illustrate the model's local activity. Taken together, this reframes a flat SAE inventory as an internal knowledge graph that converts feature-level interpretability into a global map of model knowledge and enables audits of reasoning faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建领域特定的稀疏自编码器特征图谱，将扁平的特征库转化为可读的知识图谱，用于揭示语言模型内部的概念结构、关联关系和推理路径。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器虽然能从语言模型中提取大量可解释特征，但扁平的、无结构的特征集合难以直接使用，无法体现特征之间的关联与层次关系。
AI.method: 1）利用对比激活和多阶段过滤构建严格的领域特定概念集合；2）构建共现图（层级概念结构）和基于transcoder的机制图（跨层稀疏路径）；3）自动化边标注生成可读知识图谱。
AI.result: 在生物学教材案例中，生成的图谱能够恢复章节级别的层级结构，揭示跨主题的桥梁概念，并将包含数千个特征的杂乱句子级活动转化为紧凑可读的视图。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将扁平的SAE特征库重新框架为内部知识图谱，将特征级可解释性提升为模型知识的全局地图，并支持推理忠实性的审计。

title: BrickNet: Graph-Backed Generative Brick Assembly
summary: We train a language model to generate LEGO-brick build sequences. While prior work has been restricted to discrete, voxel-like towers, we consider a much broader set of pieces, encompassing thousands of part types with diverse connection semantics. To enable this, we first collect a large-scale dataset of over 100,000 human-designed LDraw brick objects and scenes. The complexity of our setting makes it challenging to autoregressively assemble structures that satisfy physical constraints. When predicting block pose directly, build sequences quickly become invalid after a small number of steps. Although pieces are placed in 3D space, it is the spatial relationships of the parts which define the whole. With this in mind, we design a graph-based program representation that parametrizes structure through connectivity, improving the physical grounding of generated sequences. To enable future applications, we make our dataset and models available for research purposes. https://kulits.github.io/BrickNet

AI.tldr: 该论文训练了一个语言模型来生成LEGO砖块搭建序列，涉及数千种零件类型和复杂连接语义。通过收集超过10万个人类设计的LDraw砖块对象数据集，并设计基于图的程序表示来参数化结构连接性，提高了生成序列的物理可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作局限于离散的、体素化的塔状结构，无法处理更广泛的零件类型和多样化的连接语义，因此需要一种能处理复杂物理约束的自动组装方法。
AI.method: 首先构建包含超过10万个人类设计的LDraw砖块对象的大规模数据集，然后设计基于图的程序表示，通过连接性参数化结构，以改进生成序列的物理基础。
AI.result: 所提出的图表示方法相比直接预测块位姿的序列方法，能更好地维持物理约束，生成更有效的搭建序列。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的程序表示方法能有效提升复杂LEGO结构生成的物理可行性，数据集和模型已公开供研究使用。

title: ClawTrace: Cost-Aware Tracing for LLM Agent Skill Distillation
summary: Skill-distillation pipelines learn reusable rules from LLM agent trajectories, but they lack a key signal: how much each step costs. Without per-step cost, a pipeline cannot distinguish adding a missing step to fix a bug from removing an expensive step that never affected the outcome. We introduce ClawTrace, an agent tracing platform that records every LLM call, tool use, and sub-agent spawn during an agent session and compiles each session into a TraceCard: a compact YAML summary with per-step USD cost, token counts, and redundancy flags. Built on ClawTrace, CostCraft is a distillation pipeline that reads TraceCards and produces three types of skill patches. Preserve patches keep behaviors that led to success. Prune patches remove expensive steps that did not matter, each backed by a counterfactual argument against a named high-cost step. Repair patches fix failures grounded in oracle evidence. Ablations on 30 held-out SpreadsheetBench tasks show that both cost attribution and prune patches independently reduce quality regressions. When the same skill is applied to 30 unrelated SkillsBench tasks, an unexpected asymmetry emerges: prune rules transferred across benchmarks and cut median cost by 32%, while preserve rules, trained on benchmark-specific conventions, caused regressions on new task types. We release ClawTrace and TraceCards as open infrastructure for cost-aware agent research.

AI.tldr: ClawTrace 和 CostCraft 是用于 LLM agent 轨迹的细粒度成本感知蒸馏工具，通过 TraceCard 记录每一步的美元成本、Token 数量和冗余标记，并生成三种技能补丁（保留、剪枝、修复），实验表明剪枝规则可跨基准迁移并降低 32% 中位数成本。
AI.motivation: 现有技能蒸馏流程缺乏每步成本信号，无法区分"为修复 bug 增加步骤"和"移除不影响结果的昂贵步骤"这两种行为。
AI.method: 构建 ClawTrace 代理追踪平台，记录每步 LLM 调用、工具使用和子代理生成，生成 TraceCard（YAML 格式，含 USD 成本、Token 数、冗余标记）。在此基础上开发 CostCraft 蒸馏流程，生成三类补丁：Preserve（保留成功行为）、Prune（移除昂贵冗余步骤，附带反事实论证）、Repair（基于 oracle 证据修复失败）。
AI.result: 在 30 个 SpreadsheetBench 任务上，成本归因和剪枝补丁独立降低了质量回归。在 30 个 SkillsBench 任务上，剪枝规则跨基准迁移，中位数成本降低 32%；保留规则因依赖基准特定惯例，在新任务上产生回归。
AI.conclusion: 成本感知的蒸馏能够有效识别并去除冗余的高成本步骤，且剪枝规则具有更好的跨任务泛化能力。ClawTrace 和 TraceCards 以开源形式发布，推动成本感知 agent 研究。

title: LegalDrill: Diagnosis-Driven Synthesis for Legal Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: Small language models (SLMs) are promising for real-world deployment due to their efficiency and low operational cost. However, their limited capacity struggles with high-stakes legal reasoning tasks that require coherent statute interpretation and logically consistent deduction. Furthermore, training SLMs for such tasks demands high-quality, concise reasoning trajectories, which are prohibitively expensive to manually collect and difficult to curate via standard rejection sampling, lacking granularity beyond final verdicts. To address these challenges, we propose {LegalDrill}, a diagnosis-driven synthesis framework that extracts and iteratively refines reasoning trajectories from a capable teacher via fine-grained prompting, then a self-reflective verification is employed to adaptively select the most effective data for the SLM student. The resulting data empower SLM training through supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. Extensive experiments on several legal benchmarks demonstrate that {LegalDrill} significantly bolsters the legal reasoning capabilities of representative SLMs while bypassing the need for scarce expert annotations, paving a scalable path toward practical legal reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: LegalDrill是一个诊断驱动的合成框架，通过从强教师模型中提取并精炼推理轨迹，再经自反验证筛选最有效数据，训练小型语言模型完成法律推理任务，在多个法律基准上显著提升了SLM的推理能力，无需昂贵的专家标注。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型在部署中效率高、成本低，但自身容量有限，难以处理需要连贯法条解释和逻辑一致推理的高风险法律任务；同时，训练此类模型所需的高质量推理轨迹难以手动收集，标准拒绝采样方法又缺乏细粒度反馈。
AI.method: 提出LegalDrill框架：1) 从能力强的教师模型中通过细粒度提示提取并迭代精炼推理轨迹；2) 采用自反式验证机制自适应选择最有效的数据；3) 将筛选后的数据用于小语言模型的监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。
AI.result: 在多个法律基准评测上，LegalDrill显著增强了小语言模型的法律推理能力，证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LegalDrill为实用化法律推理系统提供了一条可扩展的路径，绕过了稀缺的专家标注需求，让小语言模型也能胜任复杂的法律推理任务。

title: DRACULA: Hunting for the Actions Users Want Deep Research Agents to Execute
summary: Scientific Deep Research (DR) agents answer user queries by synthesizing research papers into multi-section reports. User feedback can improve their utility, but existing protocols only score the final report, making it hard to study and learn which intermediate actions DR agents should take to improve reports. We collect DRACULA, the first dataset with user feedback on intermediate actions for DR. Over five weeks, nineteen expert CS researchers ask queries to a DR system that proposes actions (e.g., "Add a section on datasets"). Our users select actions they prefer, then judge whether an output report applied their selections successfully, yielding 8,103 action preferences and 5,230 execution judgments. After confirming a DR agent can execute DRACULA's actions, we study the predictability of user-preferred actions via simulation-how well LLMs predict the actions users select-a step toward learning to generate useful actions. We discover: (1) LLM judges initially struggle to predict action selections, but improve most when using a user's full selection history, rather than self-reported or extrapolated user context signals; (2) Users' selections for the same query differ based on unstated goals, bottlenecking simulation and motivating affordances that let users steer reports; and (3) Our simulation results inform an online intervention that generates new actions based on the user's past interactions, which users pick most often in follow-up studies. Overall, while work extensively studies execution, DRACULA reveals a key challenge is deciding which actions to execute in the first place. We open-source DRACULA's study design, user feedback, and simulation tasks to spur future work on action feedback for long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 本文首次构建了包含中间动作用户反馈的数据集DRACULA（由19位专家在5周内收集），发现LLM模拟用户动作偏好时面临两大瓶颈：用户选择难以预测且存在未言明的目标差异，最终表明决定执行哪些动作比如何执行更为关键。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究（DR）智能体仅通过最终报告得分获取用户反馈，无法有效学习和改进中间动作（如添加数据集章节），因此需要收集细粒度的动作级用户偏好数据。
AI.method: 邀请19位计算机科学专家在5周内使用DR系统，系统会建议中间动作（如"添加数据集章节"），用户选择偏好的动作并判断最终报告是否成功执行了这些选择，共收集8,103个动作偏好和5,230个执行判断。
AI.result: (1) LLM预测用户动作选择时表现不佳，但使用完整选择历史可最大程度提升效果；(2) 用户对相同查询的选择因未言明的目标而异，限制了仿真的有效性；(3) 基于过去交互生成新动作的在线干预策略在后续研究中被用户最频繁选择。
AI.conclusion: DR智能体的核心挑战不在于执行动作，而在于"决定执行哪些动作"；DRACULA数据集揭示了动作选择本身的预测困难，为长程智能体的动作反馈研究提供了基础。

title: Time-Series Forecasting in Safety-Critical Environments: An EU-AI-Act-Compliant Open-Source Package / Zeitreihenprognose in sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen: Ein KI-VO-konformes Open-Source-Paket
comment: Bilingual twin paper: English version first, German original below (91 pages total). Single shared bibliography
summary: With spotforecast2-safe we present an integrated Compliance-by-Design approach to Python-based point forecasting of time series in safety-critical environments. A review of the relevant open-source tooling shows that existing compliance solutions operate consistently outside of the library to be used - e.g. as scanners, templates, or runtime layers. spotforecast2-safe takes the inverse approach and anchors the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the EU AI Act, in German: KI-VO), of IEC 61508, of the ISA/IEC 62443 standards series, and of the Cyber Resilience Act within the library: in application-programming-interface contracts, persistence formats, and continuous-integration gates. The approach is operationalised by four non-negotiable code-development rules (zero dead code, deterministic processing, fail-safe handling, minimal dependencies) together with the corresponding process rules (model card, executable docstrings, CI workflows, Common-Platform-Enumeration (CPE) identifier, REUSE-conformant licensing, release pipeline). Interactive visualisation, hyperparameter tuning and automated machine learning (AutoML), as well as deep-learning and large-language-model backends are deliberately excluded, because each of these components either enlarges the attack surface, introduces non-determinism, or impairs reproducibility. A bidirectional traceability matrix maps every regulatory provision onto the corresponding mechanism in the code; an end-to-end example of European-market electricity generation, transmission, and consumption forecasting demonstrates the application. The package is open-source and available under Affero General Public License (AGPL) 3.0-or-later.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了spotforecast2-safe，一个面向安全关键环境中时间序列点预测的合规性设计框架，将EU AI Act、IEC 61508、IEC 62443和Cyber Resilience Act等法规要求内嵌到Python库的API契约、持久化格式和CI流程中，通过四项不可协商的编码规则和六项流程规则实现合规自动化。
AI.motivation: 现有开源合规方案（如扫描器、模板、运行时层）均在库外部运作，缺乏将法规要求直接嵌入库内部设计的集成方案，难以满足安全关键场景下时间序列预测的严格合规需求。
AI.method: 采用逆向合规设计思路，将EU AI Act、IEC 61508、ISA/IEC 62443和Cyber Resilience Act的法规要求直接锚定在库的API契约、持久化格式和CI门禁中；制定了四项不可协商的编码规则（零死代码、确定性处理、故障安全处理、最小依赖）和六项流程规则（模型卡、可执行文档字符串、CI工作流、CPE标识符、REUSE合规许可、发布流水线）；构建双向可追溯性矩阵将法规条款映射到代码机制。
AI.result: 提供了一个开源Python包（AGPL 3.0-or-later），通过双向可追溯性矩阵验证合规覆盖；在欧洲电力市场发电、输电和用电预测的端到端案例中展示了实际应用效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将合规要求直接内嵌于库设计而非外部附加层，能更有效地保障安全关键场景中时间序列预测的合规性；明确排除了交互式可视化、超参数调优、AutoML、深度学习和大语言模型后端，以避免攻击面扩大、非确定性和可重复性受损。

title: Resource-Lean Lexicon Induction for German Dialects
summary: Automatic induction of high-quality dictionaries is essential for building lexical resources, yet low-resource languages and dialects pose several challenges: limited access to annotators, high degree of spelling variations, and poor performance of large language models (LLMs). We empirically show that statistical models (random forests) trained on string similarity features are surprisingly effective for inducing German dialect lexicons. They outperform LLMs, enable cross-dialect transfer, and offer a lightweight data-driven alternative. We evaluate our models intrinsically on bilingual lexicon induction (BLI) and extrinsically on dialect information retrieval (IR). On BLI, random forests outperform Mistral-123b while being more resource-lean. On dialect IR with BM25, using our dialect dictionaries for query expansion yields relative improvements of up to 28.9% in nDCG@10 and 50.7% in Recall@100. Motivated by the resource scarcity in dialects, we further investigate the extent to which models transfer across different German dialects, and their performance under varying amounts of training data.

AI.tldr: 本文证明基于字符串相似度特征的随机森林模型在德语方言词典自动构建中效果显著，性能优于大型语言模型，且能实现跨方言迁移，在词典归纳和信息检索任务上均取得大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言和方言面临标注人员少、拼写变异大、大语言模型性能差等挑战，需要高效轻量的词典自动归纳方法。
AI.method: 使用基于字符串相似度特征训练的随机森林模型，进行双语词典归纳；并将生成的方言词典用于BM25查询扩展以提升信息检索性能。
AI.result: 在BLI任务上，随机森林超越Mistral-123b；在方言IR任务上，使用生成的方言词典进行查询扩展，nDCG@10提升28.9%，Recall@100提升50.7%。
AI.conclusion: 随机森林作为一种轻量级数据驱动方法，是低资源方言词典归纳的有效替代方案，具备跨方言迁移能力和数据效率优势。

title: ZenBrain: A Neuroscience-Inspired 7-Layer Memory Architecture for Autonomous AI Systems
comment: Pre-print of NeurIPS 2026 main-track submission. Earliest preprint version on Zenodo 31 March 2026 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19353664); cross-posted to TDCommons (dpubs_series/9683, 1 April 2026). Six Zenodo revisions and three TDCommons revisions through 9 April 2026 (Zenodo concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19353663). 41 pages, 22 tables, 2 figures
summary:
Despite a century of empirical memory research, existing AI agent memory systems rely on system-engineering metaphors (virtual-memory paging, flat LLM storage, Zettelkasten notes), none integrating principles of consolidation, forgetting, and reconsolidation.
  We present ZenBrain, a multi-layer memory architecture integrating fifteen neuroscience models. It implements seven memory layers (working, short-term, episodic, semantic, procedural, core, cross-context) orchestrated by nine foundational algorithms (Two-Factor Synaptic Model, vmPFC-coupled FSRS, Simulation-Selection sleep, Bayesian confidence, and five more) plus six new Predictive Memory Architecture (PMA) components: a four-channel NeuromodulatorEngine, prediction-error-gated ReconsolidationEngine, TripleCopyMemory with divergent decay, four-dimensional PriorityMap with amygdala fast-path, StabilityProtector (NogoA/HDAC3 analogue), and MetacognitiveMonitor for bias detection.
  The 15-algorithm ablation reveals a cooperative survival network: under stress, 9 of 15 algorithms become individually critical (delta-Q up to -93.7%, Wilcoxon, 10 seeds, alpha=0.005). Simulation-Selection sleep achieves 37% stability improvement (p<0.005) with 47.4% storage reduction. TripleCopyMemory retains S(t)=0.912 at 30 days; PriorityMap reaches NDCG@10=0.997.
  Multi-layer routing beats a flat single-layer baseline by 20.7% F1 on LoCoMo (p<0.005) and 19.5% on MemoryArena (p=0.015). On LongMemEval-500, ZenBrain holds the highest mean rank on all 12 system-judge cells (4 systems x 3 LLM judges), three-judge mean J=0.545 vs letta=0.485, a-mem=0.414, mem0=0.394; all 9 pair-wise contrasts clear Bonferroni (alpha=0.05/18, min p=6.2e-31, d in [0.18, 0.52]). Under LongMemEval's binary judge, ZenBrain reaches 91.3% of oracle accuracy at 1/106th the per-query token budget. Open-source with 11,589 automated test cases.

AI.tldr: ZenBrain是一个融合15种神经科学模型的多层记忆架构，包含7个记忆层和9种基础算法，在多项长期记忆评估基准上显著优于现有AI记忆系统（如letta、a-mem、mem0），并在1/106的token预算下达到Oracle准确率的91.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体的记忆系统均基于系统工程隐喻（如虚拟内存分页、扁平LLM存储、Zettelkasten笔记），未能整合神经科学中的巩固、遗忘和再巩固等核心原则，因此需要一种受神经科学启发的记忆架构。
AI.method: 提出ZenBrain多层记忆架构，实现7个记忆层（工作记忆、短时记忆、情景记忆、语义记忆、程序记忆、核心记忆、跨情境记忆），由9种基础算法（双因子突触模型、vmPFC耦合FSRS、模拟-选择睡眠、贝叶斯置信度等）协调，并新增6种预测性记忆架构（PMA）组件（神经调质引擎、预测误差门控再巩固引擎、三重拷贝记忆等）。
AI.result: 15算法消融实验揭示协作生存网络，9种算法在压力下变得关键（delta-Q最高-93.7%）；模拟-选择睡眠提升37%稳定性并减少47.4%存储；三重拷贝记忆30天保留S(t)=0.912；PriorityMap达到NDCG@10=0.997。多层路由在LoCoMo上F1提升20.7%，MemoryArena提升19.5%。LongMemEval-500上三裁判平均J=0.545，高于letta（0.485）、a-mem（0.414）、mem0（0.394），所有9对对比均通过Bonferroni校正。
AI.conclusion: 融合神经科学原理的记忆架构能显著提升AI智能体的长期记忆能力，ZenBrain以极低的token开销接近理论最优性能，且该架构已开源并附带11,589个自动化测试用例。

title: GenAssets: Generating in-the-wild 3D Assets in Latent Space
summary: High-quality 3D assets for traffic participants are critical for multi-sensor simulation, which is essential for the safe end-to-end development of autonomy. Building assets from in-the-wild data is key for diversity and realism, but existing neural-rendering based reconstruction methods are slow and generate assets that render well only from viewpoints close to the original observations, limiting their usefulness in simulation. Recent diffusion-based generative models build complete and diverse assets, but perform poorly on in-the-wild driving scenes, where observed actors are captured under sparse and limited fields of view, and are partially occluded. In this work, we propose a 3D latent diffusion model that learns on in-the-wild LiDAR and camera data captured by a sensor platform and generates high-quality 3D assets with complete geometry and appearance. Key to our method is a "reconstruct-then-generate" approach that first leverages occlusion-aware neural rendering trained over multiple scenes to build a high-quality latent space for objects, and then trains a diffusion model that operates on the latent space. We show our method outperforms existing reconstruction and generation based methods, unlocking diverse and scalable content creation for simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于3D潜扩散模型的方法，利用真实驾驶场景中的LiDAR和相机数据，生成具有完整几何和外观的高质量3D交通参与者资产，解决了现有重建和生成方法在稀疏视角和遮挡情况下的不足。
AI.motivation: 高质量的3D交通参与者资产对多传感器仿真至关重要，但现有神经渲染重建方法速度慢且仅能良好渲染观察视角附近的图像，而扩散生成模型在真实驾驶场景中表现不佳，因为观测视角稀疏且存在遮挡。
AI.method: 采用"先重建后生成"的策略：首先利用遮挡感知的神经渲染在多个场景中训练，构建高质量的对象潜空间；然后在该潜空间上训练扩散模型，生成具有完整几何和外观的3D资产。
AI.result: 该方法在性能上优于现有的重建和生成方法，能够为仿真解锁多样且可扩展的内容创作。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种有效利用真实驾驶场景稀疏观测数据生成高质量3D资产的方法，对自动驾驶仿真具有重要意义。

title: MarketBench: Evaluating AI Agents as Market Participants
summary: Markets are a promising way to coordinate AI agent activity for similar reasons to those used to justify markets more broadly. In order to effectively participate in markets, agents need to have informative signals of their own ability to successfully complete a task and the cost of doing so. We propose MarketBench, a benchmark for assessing whether AI agents have these capabilities. We use a 93-task subset of SWE-bench Lite, a software engineering benchmark, with six recently released LLMs as a demonstration. These LLMs are miscalibrated on both success probability and token usage, and auctions built from these self-reports diverge from a full-information allocation. A follow-up intervention where we add information about capabilities from prior experiments to the context improves calibration, but only modestly narrows the gap to a full-information benchmark. We also document the performance of a market-based scaffolding with these LLMs. Our results point to self-assessment as a key bottleneck for market-style coordination of AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MarketBench基准，用于评估AI代理在市场中自我评估能力（成功概率和成本）的校准程度。在SWE-bench Lite的93个任务上测试了6个LLM，发现它们在自我评估上存在严重偏差，导致市场分配效率远低于完全信息基准。即使通过上下文补充信息也只能小幅改善。
AI.motivation: 市场机制有望协调AI代理活动，但前提是代理能准确评估自身完成任务的能力和成本。现有LLM缺乏这种自我评估能力，亟需一个标准化的基准来衡量和改善这一能力。
AI.method: 基于SWE-bench Lite的93个任务，使用6个最新LLM进行实验。通过对比代理自我报告的成功概率和token使用量与实际情况，评估校准程度。构建拍卖模拟市场，比较自我报告分配与完全信息分配的差距。并尝试通过添加上下文历史信息进行干预。
AI.result: LLM在成功概率和token使用量上均存在严重的校准偏差。基于自我报告构建的拍卖市场分配与完全信息基准差距显著。上下文信息干预虽能改善校准，但改善幅度有限。
AI.conclusion: 自我评估能力是AI代理通过市场机制进行协调的关键瓶颈。当前LLM在这方面的不足限制了市场风格协调的有效性。

title: Reheat Nachos for Dinner? Evaluating AI Support for Cross-Cultural Communication of Neologisms
summary: Neologisms and emerging slang are central to daily conversation, yet challenging for non-native speakers (NNS) to interpret and use appropriately in cross-cultural communication with native speakers (NS). NNS increasingly make use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to learn these words. We study the utility of such tools in mediating an informal communication scenario through a human-subjects study (N=234): NNS participants learn English neologisms with AI support, write messages using the learned word to an NS friend, and judge contextual appropriateness of the neologism in two provided writing samples. Using both NS evaluator-rated communicative competence of NNS-produced writing and NNS' contextual appropriateness judgments, we compare three AI-based support conditions: AI Definition, AI Rewrite into simpler English, AI Explanation of meaning and usage, and Non-AI Dictionary for comparison. We show that AI Explanation yields the largest gains over no support in NS-rated competence, while contextual appropriateness judgments show indifference across support. NNS participants' self-reported perceptions tend to overestimate NS ratings, revealing a mismatch between perceived and actual competence. We further observe a significant gap between NNS- and NS-produced writing, highlighting the limitations of current AI tools and informing design for future tools.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过人工实验(N=234)比较了三种AI支持方式(定义、改写、解释)与非AI词典对非母语者学习英语新词和俚语的效果，发现AI解释在提升交际能力方面效果最佳，但非母语者自我感知与实际能力存在差距。
AI.motivation: 新词和俚语在日常对话中很常见，但对非母语者在跨文化交际中理解和恰当使用造成困难。非母语者越来越多地使用AI工具学习这些词汇，因此需要系统评估这些工具的实际效果。
AI.method: 进行了一项234人参与的人工受试研究。非母语者分别在AI定义、AI改写为简单英语、AI解释含义与用法三种AI支持条件以及非AI词典对照条件下学习英语新词，然后撰写消息并用两个写作样本判断语境恰当性，通过母语者评价和非母语者自我判断来比较效果。
AI.result: AI解释条件在提升母语者评价的交际能力方面效果最好；语境恰当性判断在各种支持条件下无明显差异；非母语者自我感知的交际能力往往高估了母语者的实际评价；非母语者与母语者的写作质量之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI工具在帮助非母语者学习新词方面仍有局限性，非母语者存在感知与实际能力不匹配的问题，研究结果为未来设计更好的AI辅助工具提供了依据。

title: AmaraSpatial-10K: A Spatially and Semantically Aligned 3D Dataset for Spatial Computing and Embodied AI
summary: Web-scale 3D asset collections are abundant, but rarely deployment-ready. Assets ship with arbitrary metric scale, incorrect pivots and forward axes, brittle geometry, and textures that do not support relighting, which limits their utility for embodied AI, robotics simulation, game development, and AR/VR. We present AmaraSpatial-10K, a dataset of over 10,000 synthetic 3D assets designed for downstream use rather than volume alone. Each asset is released as a metric-scaled, semantically anchored .glb with separated PBR material maps, a convex collision hull, a paired reference image, and rich multi-sentence text metadata. The dataset spans indoor objects, vehicles, architecture, creatures, and props under a unified spatial convention. Alongside the dataset, we introduce an evaluation suite for 3D asset banks. The suite comprises a continuous Scale Plausibility Score (SPS) with an LLM-as-Judge interval protocol, an LLM Concept Density score for metadata, an anchor-error metric, and a cross-modal CLIP coherence protocol, and we use it to audit AmaraSpatial-10K alongside matched subsets from Objaverse, HSSD, ABO, and GSO. Compared with Objaverse-sourced assets, we demonstrate that AmaraSpatial-10K substantially improves text-based retrieval precision (CLIP Recall@5 of 0.612 vs 0.181, a 3.4x improvement with median rank falling from 267 to 3), and we establish that it satisfies the spatial and semantic prerequisites for physics-aware scene composition and embodied-AI asset banks, leaving those downstream evaluations to future work. AmaraSpatial-10K is publicly available on Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 AmaraSpatial-10K，一个包含10,000多个高质量合成3D资产的数据集。每个资产都是公制尺度、语义锚定的.glb格式，具有分离的PBR材质贴图、凸包碰撞体、参考图像和丰富的文本元数据。同时提出了一个3D资产库评估套件，包含多个指标，实验表明该数据集在文本检索等任务上显著优于现有数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有的网络级3D资产数据集虽然数量庞大，但存在尺度任意、轴心/前向轴错误、几何质量差、纹理不支持重光照等问题，限制了它们在具身AI、机器人仿真、游戏开发和AR/VR等下游任务中的实用性。需要创建一个面向实际部署的标准化3D资产数据集。
AI.method: 1) 构建AmaraSpatial-10K数据集：超过10,000个合成3D资产，统一为公制尺度、语义锚定的.glb格式，包含分离的PBR材质贴图、凸包碰撞体、参考图像和多句文本元数据；2) 提出评估套件：包含尺度合理性分数(SPS，使用LLM-as-Judge协议)、LLM概念密度分数、锚点误差指标、跨模态CLIP一致性协议。
AI.result: 相比Objaverse来源的资产，AmaraSpatial-10K在文本检索精度上显著提升：CLIP Recall@5从0.181提升到0.612（3.4倍提升），中位数排名从267降至3。数据集满足物理感知场景合成和具身AI资产库的空间和语义先决条件。
AI.conclusion: AmaraSpatial-10K是一个高质量、标准化、面向下游部署的3D资产数据集，在文本检索等任务上大幅优于现有数据集，为具身AI和机器人仿真等领域提供了可用的基础资产库。数据集已在Hugging Face公开发布。

title: LLM-Augmented Traffic Signal Control with LSTM-Based Traffic State Prediction and Safety-Constrained Decision Support
summary: Traffic signal control is a critical task in intelligent transportation systems, yet conventional fixed-time and rule-based methods often struggle to adapt to dynamic traffic demand and provide limited decision interpretability. This study proposes an LLM-augmented traffic signal control framework that integrates LSTM-based short-term traffic state prediction, predictive phase selection, structured large language model reasoning, and safety-constrained action filtering. The LSTM module forecasts future queue length, waiting time, vehicle count, and lane occupancy based on recent intersection-level observations. A predictive controller then generates candidate signal actions, while the LLM module evaluates these actions using structured traffic-state inputs and produces congestion diagnoses, phase adjustment recommendations, and natural-language explanations. To ensure operational reliability, all LLM-generated recommendations are validated by a safety filter before execution. Simulation-based experiments in SUMO compare the proposed method with fixed-time control, rule-based control, and an LSTM-based predictive baseline under balanced demand, directional peak demand, and sudden surge scenarios. The results indicate that the proposed framework improves traffic efficiency, especially under dynamic and non-recurrent traffic conditions, while maintaining zero constraint violations after safety filtering. Overall, this study demonstrates that LLMs can enhance traffic signal control when used as constrained reasoning and decision-support modules rather than direct low-level controllers. Keywords: Intelligent Transportation Systems; Traffic Signal Control; Large Language Models; LSTM; Traffic State Prediction; Decision Support; Safety-Constrained Control; SUMO Simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种LLM增强的交通信号控制框架，结合LSTM预测、预测性相位选择、结构化LLM推理和安全约束过滤，在SUMO仿真中验证了其在动态交通场景下的效率和安全性优势。
AI.motivation: 传统固定时间和基于规则的交通信号控制方法难以适应动态交通需求，且决策可解释性有限，亟需更智能、可解释的控制方案。
AI.method: 构建LSTM短期交通状态预测模块（预测队列长度、等待时间、车辆数、车道占用率）→ 预测性控制器生成候选信号动作 → LLM模块基于结构化交通状态输入进行评估，生成拥堵诊断、相位调整建议及自然语言解释 → 安全过滤器验证后执行。
AI.result: 在SUMO仿真中，该方法在均衡需求、方向性高峰和突发激增场景下均优于固定时间控制、规则控制及LSTM预测基线，显著提升交通效率，且经安全过滤后零约束违规。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为受约束的推理与决策支持模块增强交通信号控制，而非直接的低层控制器，在动态和非重复性交通条件下尤其有效。

title: Understanding Representation Gaps Across Scales in Tropical Tree Species Classification from Drone Imagery
summary: Accurate classification of tropical tree species from unoccupied aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery remains challenging due to high species diversity and strong visual similarity among species at typical image resolutions (centimeters per pixel). In contrast, models trained on close-up citizen science photographs captured with smartphones achieve strong plant species classification performance. Recent advances in UAV data acquisition now enable the collection of close-up images that are spatially registered with top-view aerial imagery and approach the level of visual detail found in smartphone photographs, with the trade-off that such high-resolution photos cannot be acquired for many trees. In this work, we evaluate the performance of existing methods using paired top-view and close-up UAV imagery collected in a species-rich tropical forest. Through fine-tuning experiments, we quantify the performance gap between vision foundation models and in-domain generalist plant recognition models across both image types (high-resolution close-up versus coarser-resolution top-view imagery). We show that classification performance is consistently higher on close-up images than on top-view aerial imagery, and that this performance gap widens for rare species. Finally, we propose that self-supervised representation alignment across these two spatial scales offers a promising approach for integrating fine-grained visual information into canopy-level species classification models based on top-view UAV imagery. Leveraging high-resolution close-up UAV imagery to enhance canopy-level species classification could substantially improve large-scale monitoring of tropical forest biodiversity.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了利用无人机采集的近距离高分辨率影像和俯视图影像对热带树种进行分类的性能，发现近距离影像分类效果更好，尤其对于稀有物种，并提出通过自监督表示对齐方法将细粒度视觉信息整合到冠层分类模型中。
AI.motivation: 热带树种多样性高、视觉相似性强，传统俯视无人机影像分类效果有限；而基于公民科学智能手机照片的模型表现优异。近期无人机技术可采集与智能手机照片质量相当的近距离影像，但无法对所有树木采集。作者旨在量化这两种影像类型的分类性能差距，并探索利用近距离影像提升俯视影像分类的方法。
AI.method: 使用配对的俯视和近距离无人机影像数据，通过微调实验，对比视觉基础模型与领域内通用植物识别模型在两种影像类型上的分类性能，并提出自监督表示对齐方法用于跨尺度特征融合。
AI.result: 近距离影像的分类性能始终优于俯视影像，且对于稀有物种，这种性能差距更大。
AI.conclusion: 利用高分辨率近距离无人机影像增强冠层级别的树种分类是可行的，有望大幅改进热带森林生物多样性的大规模监测。

title: Agentic AI platforms for autonomous training and rule induction of human-human and virus-human protein-protein interactions
summary: We instruct an AI agent to construct two separate agentic AI platforms: one for autonomous training of predictive ML models for human-human and virus-human PPI, and the other for inducing explicit general rules governing human-human and virus-human PPI. The first agentic AI platform for autonomous training of predictive ML models for PPI is designed to consist of five AI agents that handle autonomous data collection, data verification, feature embedding, model design, and training and validation on three-way protein-disjoint cross-fold datasets. For human-human and human-virus PPIs, the final three-way protein-disjoint ensemble achieves an accuracy of 87.3% and 86.5%, respectively. For cross-checking and interpretability purposes, the second agentic AI platform is designed to replace ML predictions with human-readable rules derived from protein embeddings, physicochemical autocovariance descriptors, compartment annotations, pathway-domain overlap, and graph contexts. For human-human PPI, it is defined by a two-rule induction, whereas human-virus is induced by a more complex set of weighted rules. The rules induced by the second agentic platform align with the SHAP-identified features from the predictive ML models built by the first agentic platform. Taken together, our work demonstrates the agentic AI's ability to orchestrate from data planning to execution, and from rule induction to explanation in ML, opening the door to various applications.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了两个自主AI平台：一个用于自动训练蛋白质相互作用（PPI）预测模型（人-人PPI准确率87.3%，人-病毒PPI准确率86.5%），另一个用于提取可解释的显式规则，两者结果相互印证，展现了AI Agent从数据到规则生成的全流程能力。
AI.motivation: 现有PPI预测方法在自动化程度和可解释性上存在不足，缺乏端到端的智能体自主完成数据收集、模型训练和规则提取的系统。
AI.method: 设计两个Agentic AI平台：第一个平台包含5个AI Agent（自主数据收集、验证、特征嵌入、模型设计、训练验证），使用三重蛋白质不相交交叉验证集成模型；第二个平台基于蛋白质嵌入、理化自协方差描述符、区室注释、通路-结构域重叠和图上下文等特征，归纳显式规则。
AI.result: 人-人PPI准确率87.3%，人-病毒PPI准确率86.5%；第二个平台归纳的规则与第一个平台SHAP分析识别的关键特征一致。
AI.conclusion: 证明了Agentic AI能够从数据规划到执行、从规则归纳到模型解释的全流程自主完成，为各类应用开辟了新途径。

title: Urban Flood Observations (UFO): A hand-labeled training and validation dataset of post-flood inundation
summary: Urban flooding affects lives and infrastructure worldwide. Mapping inundation in complex urban environments from satellite imagery remains challenging due to limited spatial resolution, infrequent acquisitions, and cloud cover. We present Urban Flood Observations (UFO), a global, hand-labeled dataset of post-flood inundation in diverse urban settings. UFO comprises 215 image chips (1024 by 1024 pixels) from 14 flood events between 2017 and 2021, derived from 3 m PlanetScope imagery. Each chip is annotated with two classes: 'inundated' (all visible surface water, including floodwater and pre-existing water bodies (permanent or seasonal)) and 'non-inundated'. To demonstrate the dataset's utility, we trained a segmentation model using leave-one-event-out cross-validation, achieving a mean Intersection over Union (IoU) of 77.3. We also used UFO to evaluate two widely used surface water products, the Sentinel-1-based NASA IMPACT model and Google's 10 m Dynamic World water class, which yielded IoUs of 44.1 and 48.1, respectively. UFO is publicly available to support the development and validation of urban inundation mapping methods.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Urban Flood Observations (UFO)——一个全球性的、人工标注的城市洪水淹没数据集，包含14次洪水事件、215个图像块，基于3米分辨率的PlanetScope影像。通过分割模型验证，平均IoU达77.3，并评估了现有产品（NASA IMPACT和Dynamic World）的性能（IoU分别为44.1和48.1）。数据集已公开。
AI.motivation: 现有卫星遥感在复杂城市环境中进行洪水淹没制图存在空间分辨率有限、重访频率低、云层遮挡等问题，缺乏高质量、多样化的标注数据集支撑城市洪水探测方法的开发与验证。
AI.method: 构建UFO数据集：从2017-2021年14次洪水事件的3米分辨率PlanetScope影像中提取215个1024×1024像素的图像块，进行人工标注（淹没/非淹没两类）。采用留一事件交叉验证训练分割模型，并评估现有产品性能。
AI.result: 分割模型平均IoU为77.3；NASA IMPACT模型IoU为44.1，Google Dynamic World IoU为48.1。
AI.conclusion: UFO数据集可有效支持城市洪水淹没制图方法的开发和验证，公开可用以推动该领域研究。

title: Knowledge Vector of Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Logical reasoning serve as a central capability in LLMs and includes three main forms: deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning. In this work, we study the knowledge representations of these reasoning types in LLMs and analyze the correlations among them. Our analysis shows that each form of logical reasoning can be captured as a reasoning-specific knowledge vector in a linear representation space, yet these vectors are largely independent of each other. Motivated by cognitive science theory that these subforms of logical reasoning interact closely in the human brain, as well as our observation that the reasoning process for one type can benefit from the reasoning chain produced by another, we further propose to refine the knowledge representations of each reasoning type in LLMs to encourage complementarity between them. To this end, we design a complementary subspace-constrained refinement framework, which introduces a complementary loss that enables each reasoning vector to leverage auxiliary knowledge from the others, and a subspace constraint loss that prevents erasure of their unique characteristics. Through steering experiments along reasoning vectors, we find that refined vectors incorporating complementary knowledge yield consistent performance gains. We also conduct a mechanism-interpretability analysis of each reasoning vector, revealing insights into the shared and specific features of different reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM中演绎、归纳和溯因三种逻辑推理的知识表征，发现它们在线性空间中各自独立。受认知科学启发，提出互补子空间约束的精炼框架，通过互补损失和子空间约束损失使不同推理向量相互补充，实验表明精炼后的推理向量能带来一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM中三种逻辑推理（演绎、归纳、溯因）的知识表征及其相互关系，并基于认知科学中三者相互作用的观点，提升推理向量之间的互补性。
AI.method: 提出互补子空间约束的精炼框架，包含互补损失（使每个推理向量利用其他推理的辅助知识）和子空间约束损失（防止独特特征被擦除），通过推理向量引导实验进行验证。
AI.result: 精炼后的推理向量在融入互补知识后取得一致的性能提升，机制可解释性分析揭示了不同推理类型的共享与特有特征。
AI.conclusion: LLM中三种逻辑推理的表征可以线性表示且相互独立，通过互补子空间约束精炼可有效增强推理向量之间的互补性，提升推理性能。

title: Toward Real-World Adoption of Portrait Relighting via Hybrid Domain Knowledge Fusion
summary: The real-world adoption of portrait relighting is hindered by dataset domain gaps, camera sensitivity, and computational costs. We address these challenges with Hybrid Domain Knowledge Fusion, a paradigm that fuses the specialized strengths of synthetic, One-Light-at-A-Time (OLAT), and real-world datasets into a compact model. Our approach features specialized prior models hardened by domain-aware adaptation, followed by augmented knowledge distillation into a lightweight student model with multi-domain expertise. Our method demonstrates a 6x to 240x inference speedup while maintaining state-of-the-art (SOTA) visual quality in the experiments. Additionally, we construct a massive, high-fidelity synthetic dataset with diverse ground-truth intrinsics to support our training pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合域知识融合框架，通过合成、OLAT和真实数据集的领域感知自适应与知识蒸馏，实现6-240倍加速的人像重打光，保持SOTA视觉效果。
AI.motivation: 真实场景应用人像重打光面临数据集域差距、相机敏感度和计算成本三大挑战，现有方法难以同时兼顾效率与质量。
AI.method: 采用混合域知识融合范式：1) 使用领域感知自适应训练多个专长先验模型；2) 通过增强型知识蒸馏将多领域知识压缩到轻量学生模型中。
AI.result: 推理速度提升6-240倍，同时保持SOTA级视觉效果；构建了大规模高保真合成数据集。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效解决了人像重打光在实际部署中的效率与性能权衡问题，为轻量化实用化提供了可行方案。

title: LLM-Guided Agentic Floor Plan Parsing for Accessible Indoor Navigation of Blind and Low-Vision People
summary: Indoor navigation remains a critical accessibility challenge for the blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals, as existing solutions rely on costly per-building infrastructure. We present an agentic framework that converts a single floor plan image into a structured, retrievable knowledge base to generate safe, accessible navigation instructions with lightweight infrastructure. The system has two phases: a multi-agent module that parses the floor plan into a spatial knowledge graph through a self-correcting pipeline with iterative retry loops and corrective feedback; and a Path Planner that generates accessible navigation instructions, with a Safety Evaluator agent assessing potential hazards along each route. We evaluate the system on the real-world UMBC Math and Psychology building (floors MP-1 and MP-3) and on the CVC-FP benchmark.
