Unlike standard confidence measures, MEG utilizes Semantic Certainty Anchoring, focusing on high-IDF information-bearing tokens that better capture the semantic core of the answer. Building on MEG, we introduce MEG-RAG, a framework that trains a multimodal reranker to align retrieved evidence with the semantic anchors of the ground truth. By prioritizing high-value content based on semantic grounding rather than token probability distributions, MEG-RAG improves the accuracy and multimodal consistency of generated outputs. Extensive experiments on the M$^2$RAG benchmark show that MEG-RAG consistently outperforms strong baselines and demonstrates robust generalization across different teacher models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MEG指标和MEG-RAG框架，通过语义锚定（高IDF token）量化多模态检索证据的真实贡献，训练重排序器提升生成准确性与多模态一致性，在M²RAG基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MRAG系统难以区分检索到的多模态数据是否真正支持答案的语义核心，而现有指标（如基于位置的置信度）无法捕捉多模态实体的信息密度。
AI.method: 提出MEG（多模态证据接地）指标，利用语义确定性锚定（Semantic Certainty Anchoring）聚焦高IDF信息承载token；在此基础上构建MEG-RAG框架，训练多模态重排序器，使检索证据与答案的语义锚点对齐。
AI.result: 在M²RAG基准上的实验表明，MEG-RAG一致优于强基线方法，并且在不同教师模型上展现出鲁棒的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于语义锚定的证据接地方法能更有效地对齐检索证据与答案核心语义，从而提升多模态RAG系统的准确性和一致性。

title: BurstGP: Enhancing Raw Burst Image Super Resolution with Generative Priors
summary: Burst image super resolution (BISR) aims to construct a single high-resolution (HR) image by aggregating information from multiple low-resolution (LR) frames, relying on temporal redundancy and spatial coherence across the burst. While conventional methods achieve impressive results, they often struggle with complex textures and oversmoothing. Diffusion models, particularly those pretrained on high-quality data, have shown remarkable capability in generating realistic details for image and video super-resolution. However, their potential remains largely under-explored in BISR, where existing approaches typically rely on task-specific diffusion models trained from scratch and operate on single-frame reconstructions. In this work, we propose BurstGP, a novel diffusion-based solution for BISR, which leverages generative priors of recent foundation models to overcome these issues. In particular, we build a multiframe-aware diffusion model on top of a conventional BISR approach, which boosts image quality with minimal loss to fidelity. Further, we introduce (i) a novel degradation-aware conditioning mechanism, which controls synthesis of fine details based on the estimated degradation in the input, and (ii) a robust sRGB-to-lRGB inverter, enabling us to utilize generative multiframe (video) sRGB priors, while operating with raw input and lRGB output images. Empirically, we demonstrate that BurstGP outperforms the existing state of the art, both quantitatively (especially with respect to perceptual metrics, including MUSIQ and LPIPS) and qualitatively. In particular, our proposed method excels at recovering richer textures and finer structural details, highlighting the potential of video priors for BISR over traditional methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BurstGP，一种基于扩散模型的 burst 图像超分辨率方法，利用多帧感知扩散模型、退化感知条件机制和 sRGB-to-lRGB 逆变器，在感知质量上超越现有 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 BISR 方法处理复杂纹理时容易出现过度平滑，而扩散模型在超分辨率中潜力巨大，但尚未充分用于 BISR，且已有方法通常从头训练任务特定扩散模型，仅进行单帧重建。
AI.method: (1) 在传统 BISR 方法基础上构建多帧感知扩散模型；(2) 提出退化感知条件机制，根据输入退化估计控制细节合成；(3) 设计鲁棒的 sRGB-to-lRGB 逆变器，使模型能利用视频 sRGB 先验同时处理 raw 输入和 lRGB 输出。
AI.result: 在感知指标（MUSIQ、LPIPS）上超越现有 SOTA，能恢复更丰富的纹理和更精细的结构细节。
AI.conclusion: BurstGP 表明视频先验在 BISR 中相比传统方法具有显著优势，为利用基础模型的生成先验提升 burst 超分质量提供了有效方案。

title: Learning to Rotate: Temporal and Semantic Rotary Encoding for Sequential Modeling
summary:
Every Transformer architecture dedicates enormous capacity to learning rich representations in semantic embedding space -- yet the rotation manifold acted upon by Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) has been treated as a fixed, hand-crafted structure, populated only by discrete ordinal indices. We argue that this rotation space is a largely overlooked second dimension of expressivity in the attention mechanism, one whose systematic exploration may open a new door for attention-based architectures. The analogy to complex numbers is instructive: just as introducing the imaginary axis -- orthogonal to and independent of the real line -- unlocked new algebraic structure once believed impossible, treating the rotation manifold as a learnable, signal-conditioned space opens an orthogonal degree of freedom in attention. In this framing, the token embedding encodes the semantic (real) component of a representation -- what a token means -- while the rotation encodes its dynamic (imaginary) component -- how it relates to every other token across time, position, and context.
  We introduce SIREN-RoPE, a concrete instantiation of this idea, which populates the rotation dimension with heterogeneous signals -- continuous timestamps, cyclical temporal patterns, and categorical metadata -- via a dual-branch Sinusoidal Representation Network (SIREN). As a proof of concept, we evaluate on a production-scale news feed dataset from a major social network using a generative recommender as the ranking model, demonstrating that activating this hidden dimension yields consistent improvements across calibration and ranking objectives with negligible computational overhead. We invite the community to view the rotation space not as a solved positional-encoding detail, but as an untapped axis whose rich structure may prove as consequential for attention as the imaginary unit proved for algebra.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将Transformer中的旋转位置编码（RoPE）的旋转空间从固定结构转变为可学习的、信号条件化的空间，并通过SIREN-RoPE实例化，在新闻推荐场景下验证了该方法能提升校准与排序效果。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer架构中，旋转位置编码（RoPE）的旋转空间被视为固定、手工设计的结构，仅填充离散的位置索引，忽略了这一维度在注意力机制中作为表达性第二维度的潜力。
AI.method: 提出SIREN-RoPE，通过双分支正弦表示网络（SIREN）将连续时间戳、周期性时间模式及类别元数据等异构信号填充到旋转维度中，将旋转空间变为可学习的、信号条件化的空间。
AI.result: 在大型社交网络的新闻推荐数据集上，使用生成式推荐模型作为排序模型，SIREN-RoPE在校准和排序目标上均取得一致改进，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 旋转空间不应被视为已解决的位置编码细节，而是一个未被充分利用的维度，其对注意力机制的意义可能类似于虚数单位对代数领域的革命性影响。

title: Skill Retrieval Augmentation for Agentic AI
summary: As large language models (LLMs) evolve into agentic problem solvers, they increasingly rely on external, reusable skills to handle tasks beyond their native parametric capabilities. In existing agent systems, the dominant strategy for incorporating skills is to explicitly enumerate available skills within the context window. However, this strategy fails to scale: as skill corpora expand, context budgets are consumed rapidly, and the agent becomes markedly less accurate in identifying the right skill. To this end, this paper formulates Skill Retrieval Augmentation (SRA), a new paradigm in which agents dynamically retrieve, incorporate, and apply relevant skills from large external skill corpora on demand. To make this problem measurable, we construct a large-scale skill corpus and introduce SRA-Bench, the first benchmark for decomposed evaluation of the full SRA pipeline, covering skill retrieval, skill incorporation, and end-task execution. SRA-Bench contains 5,400 capability-intensive test instances and 636 manually constructed gold skills, which are mixed with web-collected distractor skills to form a large-scale corpus of 26,262 skills. Extensive experiments show that retrieval-based skill augmentation can substantially improve agent performance, validating the promise of the paradigm. At the same time, we uncover a fundamental gap in skill incorporation: current LLM agents tend to load skills at similar rates, regardless of whether a gold skill is retrieved or whether the task actually requires external capabilities. This shows that the bottleneck in skill augmentation lies not only in retrieval but also in the base model's ability to determine which skill to load and when external loading is actually needed. These findings position SRA as a distinct research problem and establish a foundation for the scalable augmentation of capabilities in future agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出技能检索增强（SRA）新范式，让LLM智能体从大规模外部技能库中动态检索并应用相关技能，并构建了首个全流程评估基准SRA-Bench。实验发现，检索能提升性能，但智能体在技能加载决策上存在根本性瓶颈——无论是否检索到正确技能，都会以相似速率加载，表明瓶颈不仅在于检索，更在于模型判断何时需要加载何种技能的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统将所有可用技能显式列举在上下文窗口中的策略无法规模化：随着技能库膨胀，上下文预算迅速耗尽，智能体识别正确技能的准确性也显著下降。因此需要一种新的范式来解决大规模外部技能库场景下的技能检索与利用问题。
AI.method: 提出Skill Retrieval Augmentation (SRA)范式，智能体按需动态检索、整合和应用相关技能。构建SRA-Bench基准，包含5,400个能力密集型测试实例、636个人工构建的黄金技能和26,262个干扰技能构成的大规模技能库，对技能检索、技能整合和最终任务执行进行分解评估。
AI.result: 基于检索的技能增强能显著提升智能体性能。但发现一个根本性差距：当前LLM智能体无论是否检索到黄金技能、无论任务是否真的需要外部能力，都会以相似速率加载技能，说明技能加载决策能力存在瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: SRA应成为一个独立的研究问题，未来的智能体系统需要同时改进检索能力和基础模型的技能加载决策能力，以实现能力的可规模化增强。

title: Emotion-Conditioned Short-Horizon Human Pose Forecasting with a Lightweight Predictive World Model
summary: Short-term human pose prediction plays a crucial role in interactive systems, assistive robots, and emotion-aware human-computer interaction[1-3]. While current trajectory prediction models primarily rely on geometric motion cues, they often overlook the underlying emotional signals influencing human motion dynamics[4-5]. This paper investigates whether facial expression-derived emotion embeddings can provide auxiliary conditional signals for short-term pose prediction. To further evaluate multimodal conditionation in a recursive prediction setting, we propose a lightweight autoregressive predictive world model that performs 15-step rolling pose prediction. This framework combines pose keypoints with emotion embeddings through a learnable gating mechanism and performs autoregressive unfolding prediction using a recurrent sequence model based on a two-layer LSTM architecture. Experiments were conducted on two small-scale pose-emotion video datasets: controlled motion sequences with minimal facial expression changes and, natural emotion-driven motion sequences with considerable facial expression changes. The results show that simple multimodal fusion does not consistently improve prediction accuracy, while normalized gating fusion significantly enhances the performance of emotion-driven motion sequences. Furthermore, counterfactual perturbation experiments demonstrate that the predicted trajectory exhibits measurable sensitivity to changes in multimodal input, suggesting that facial expression embeddings act as auxiliary conditional signals rather than redundant features. In summary, these results indicate that incorporating facial expression-derived emotion embeddings into emotion-conditional short-term pose prediction based on a lightweight predictive world model architecture is a feasible approach.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将面部表情情感嵌入作为辅助条件信号用于短期人体姿态预测，提出一个轻量级自回归预测世界模型，通过可学习的门控机制融合姿态关键点和情感嵌入，在情感驱动运动序列上取得显著效果提升。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹预测模型主要依赖几何运动线索，忽略了影响人体运动动态的潜在情感信号，本文旨在探究面部表情情感嵌入能否为短期姿态预测提供辅助条件信号。
AI.method: 提出轻量级自回归预测世界模型，采用双层LSTM架构的递归序列模型，通过可学习门控机制融合姿态关键点与情感嵌入，执行15步滚动姿态预测。
AI.result: 简单多模态融合不能一致提升预测精度，而归一化门控融合显著提升了情感驱动运动序列的性能；反事实扰动实验表明预测轨迹对多模态输入变化具有可测量的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 将面部表情情感嵌入融入情感条件的短期姿态预测是可行的，情感嵌入作为辅助条件信号而非冗余特征。

title: Evaluation of Pose Estimation Systems for Sign Language Translation
comment: Accepted at LREC 2026 Workshop on the Representation and Processing of Sign Languages. O'Brien and Sant contributed equally to this paper. 16 pages, 6 figures
summary:
Many sign language translation (SLT) systems operate on pose sequences instead of raw video to reduce input dimensionality, improve portability, and partially anonymize signers. The choice of pose estimator is often treated as an implementation detail, with systems defaulting to widely available tools such as MediaPipe Holistic or OpenPose. We present a systematic comparison of pose estimators for pose-based SLT, covering widely used baselines (MediaPipe Holistic, OpenPose) and newer whole-body/high-capacity models (MMPose WholeBody, OpenPifPaf, AlphaPose, SDPose, Sapiens, SMPLest-X). We quantify downstream impact by training a controlled SLT pipeline on RWTH-PHOENIX-Weather 2014 where only the pose representation varies, evaluating with BLEU and BLEURT.
  To contextualize translation outcomes, we analyze temporal stability, missing hand keypoints, and robustness to occlusion using higher-resolution videos from the Signsuisse dataset. SDPose and Sapiens achieve the best translation performance (BLEU ~11.5), outperforming the common MediaPipe baseline (BLEU ~10). In occlusion cases, Sapiens is correct in all tested instances (15/15), while OpenPifPaf fails in nearly all (1/15) and also yields the weakest translation scores. Estimators that frequently leave out hand keypoints are associated with lower BLEU/BLEURT. We release code that can be used not only to reproduce our experiments, but also considerably lowers the barrier for other researchers to use alternative pose estimators.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了多种姿态估计器（MediaPipe Holistic、OpenPose、MMPose WholeBody、OpenPifPaf、AlphaPose、SDPose、Sapiens、SMPLest-X）用于姿态序列手语翻译（SLT）的效果。在RWTH-PHOENIX-Weather 2014数据集上，SDPose和Sapiens表现最佳（BLEU ~11.5），优于常用基线MediaPipe（BLEU ~10）。OpenPifPaf在遮挡场景下几乎完全失败（1/15正确），且翻译分数最低。缺失手部关键点的估计器与较低BLEU/BLEURT分数相关。
AI.motivation: 现有姿态序列手语翻译系统通常默认使用现成的姿态估计工具（如MediaPipe Holistic、OpenPose），但缺乏对这些估计器在下游SLT任务中性能的系统性比较，导致姿态估计器的选择成为被忽视的实现细节。
AI.method: 在RWTH-PHOENIX-Weather 2014数据集上训练了受控SLT流水线，仅改变姿态表示方式，使用BLEU和BLEURT评估翻译效果。同时利用Signsuisse高分辨视频分析时间稳定性、手部关键点缺失和遮挡鲁棒性。
AI.result: SDPose和Sapiens达到最佳翻译性能（BLEU ~11.5），优于MediaPipe基线（BLEU ~10）。遮挡场景下Sapiens全部正确（15/15），OpenPifPaf几乎全部失败（1/15）且翻译得分最低。频繁缺失手部关键点的估计器与较低BLEU/BLEURT相关。
AI.conclusion: 姿态估计器的选择对SLT系统性能有显著影响，SDPose和Sapiens是较优选择，手部关键点的完整性对翻译质量至关重要。论文开源代码便于研究人员使用不同姿态估计器。

title: $Z^2$-Sampling: Zero-Cost Zigzag Trajectories for Semantic Alignment in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have achieved unprecedented success in text-aligned generation, largely driven by Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). However, standard CFG operates strictly on instantaneous gradients, omitting the intrinsic curvature of the data manifold. Recent methods like Zigzag-sampling (Z-Sampling) explicitly traverse multi-step forward-backward trajectories to probe this curvature, significantly improving semantic alignment. Yet, these explicit traversals triple the Neural Function Evaluation (NFE) cost and introduce unconstrained truncation errors from off-manifold evaluations, causing cumulative drift from the true marginal distribution. In this paper, we theoretically demonstrate that the explicit zigzag sequence is topologically reducible. We propose Implicit Z-Sampling, rigorously proving that intermediate states can be algebraically annihilated via operator dualities, physically eliminating off-manifold approximation errors. To push sampling efficiency to its theoretical lower bound, we introduce $Z^2$-Sampling (Zero-cost Zigzag Sampling). Exploiting the Probability Flow ODE's temporal coherence, $Z^2$-Sampling couples implicit algebraic collapse with a dynamically cached Temporal Semantic Surrogate. This restores the standard 2-NFE baseline without sacrificing semantic exploration. We formally prove via Backward Error Analysis that this discrete collapse inherently synthesizes a directional derivative curvature penalty. Finally, extensive evaluations demonstrate that $Z^2$-Sampling structurally shatters the performance-efficiency Pareto frontier. We validate its universal applicability across diverse architectures (U-Nets, DiTs) and modalities (image/video), establishing seamless orthogonality with advanced alignment frameworks (AYS, Diffusion-DPO).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Z²-Sampling（零成本锯齿采样），通过算子对偶性代数消除中间状态，在保持标准2-NFE计算量的同时实现对数据流形曲率的隐式探索，打破了性能-效率帕累托边界。
AI.motivation: 现有锯齿采样（Z-Sampling）虽能通过显式前向-后向轨迹探索数据流形曲率以提升语义对齐，但导致NFE成本增加三倍，且离流形评估引入截断误差，造成累积漂移。
AI.method: 理论证明显式锯齿序列可拓扑约简；提出隐式Z-Sampling，通过算子对偶性代数消除中间状态；进一步提出Z²-Sampling，利用概率流ODE的时间相干性，将隐式代数坍缩与动态缓存的时序语义代理耦合，恢复标准2-NFE基线。
AI.result: 通过向后误差分析证明离散坍缩本质上合成了方向导数曲率惩罚；广泛实验表明Z²-Sampling在结构上打破了性能-效率帕累托边界，在U-Net和DiT架构、图像/视频模态上均验证了普适性，并与AYS、Diffusion-DPO等对齐框架正交兼容。
AI.conclusion: Z²-Sampling在零额外NFE成本下实现了对数据流形曲率的有效探索，从而在语义对齐和采样效率之间取得了最优权衡。

title: Looking for the Bottleneck in Fine-grained Temporal Relation Classification
summary:
Temporal relation classification is the task of determining the temporal relation between pairs of temporal entities in a text.
  Despite recent advancements in natural language processing, temporal relation classification remains a considerable challenge.
  Early attempts framed this task using a comprehensive set of temporal relations between events and temporal expressions.
  However, due to the task complexity, datasets have been progressively simplified, leading recent approaches to focus on the relations between event pairs and to use only a subset of relations.
  In this work, we revisit the broader goal of classifying interval relations between temporal entities by considering the full set of relations that can hold between two time intervals.
  The proposed approach, Interval from Point, involves first classifying the point relations between the endpoints of the temporal entities and then decoding these point relations into an interval relation.
  Evaluation on the TempEval-3 dataset shows that this approach can yield effective results, achieving a temporal awareness score of $70.1$ percent, a new state-of-the-art on this benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Interval from Point方法，先分类时间实体端点的点关系，再解码为区间关系，在TempEval-3数据集上达到70.1%的时序感知分数，创下新纪录。
AI.motivation: 现有方法简化了时序关系分类任务，只关注事件对之间的子集关系，忽略了时间区间之间的完整关系集合，作者希望回归更全面的分类目标。
AI.method: 提出Interval from Point方法：首先分类时间实体端点之间的点关系（如<、=、>），然后将这些点关系解码为完整的区间关系（如Allen区间代数中的关系）。
AI.result: 在TempEval-3数据集上达到70.1%的时序意识分数，实现了新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过先分类端点关系再解码为区间关系的两阶段方法，可以有效处理完整的时序关系集合，验证了该思路的有效性。

title: Oracle Noise: Faster Semantic Spherical Alignment for Interpretable Latent Optimization
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable generative capabilities, yet accurately aligning complex textual prompts with synthesized layouts remains an ongoing challenge. In these models, the initial Gaussian noise acts as a critical structural seed dictating the macroscopic layout. Recent online optimization and search methods attempt to refine this noise to enhance text-image alignment. However, relying on unconstrained Euclidean gradient ascent mathematically inflates the latent norm and destroys the standard Gaussian prior, causing severe visual artifacts like color over-saturation. Furthermore, these methods suffer from inefficient semantic routing and easily fall into the ``reward hacking'' trap of external proxy models. To address these intertwined bottlenecks, we propose Oracle Noise, a zero-shot framework reframing noise initialization as semantic-driven optimization strictly confined to a Riemannian hypersphere. Instead of relying on complex external parsers, we directly identify the most impactful structural words in the prompt to efficiently route optimization energy. By updating the noise strictly along a spherical path, we mathematically preserve the original Gaussian distribution. This geometric constraint eliminates norm inflation and unlocks aggressive step sizes for rapid convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Oracle Noise significantly accelerates semantic alignment and achieves superior aesthetics without black-box models. It completely mitigates Euclidean-induced degradation, establishing state-of-the-art performance across human preference metrics (e.g., HPSv2, ImageReward), semantic alignment (CLIP Score), and sample diversity, all within a strict 2-second optimization budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Oracle Noise，一种零样本框架，通过在黎曼超球面上进行语义驱动的噪声优化，在不破坏高斯先验的前提下，在2秒内实现文本到图像扩散模型的精准布局对齐，解决了欧几里得梯度上升导致的伪影和奖励黑客问题。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型在复杂文本与布局对齐上存在挑战，而基于欧几里得梯度上升的噪声优化方法会膨胀潜在范数、破坏高斯先验，导致色彩过饱和等视觉伪影，并存在语义路由效率低、易陷入奖励黑客陷阱等问题。
AI.method: 提出Oracle Noise，将噪声初始化重构为严格约束在黎曼超球面上的语义驱动优化。直接识别提示中最具影响力的结构词以高效路由优化能量，沿球面路径更新噪声，数学上保持原始高斯分布，消除范数膨胀并支持大步长快速收敛。
AI.result: 实验表明，Oracle Noise在2秒优化预算内显著加速语义对齐，达到更优的美学效果，完全消除欧几里得方法导致的退化，在HPSv2、ImageReward等人偏好指标、CLIP Score语义对齐和样本多样性上均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: Oracle Noise通过几何约束的噪声优化框架，有效解决了现有方法的核心瓶颈，实现了快速、高质量且无需外部黑盒模型的文本-图像对齐。

title: AusSmoke meets MultiNatSmoke: a fully-labelled diverse smoke segmentation dataset
summary: Wildfires are an escalating global concern due to the devastating impacts on the environment, economy, and human health, with notable incidents such as the 2019-2020 Australian bushfires and the 2025 California wildfires underscoring the severity of these events. AI-enabled camera-based smoke detection has emerged as a promising approach for the rapid detection of wildfires. However, existing wildfire smoke segmentation datasets that are used for training detection and segmentation models are limited in scale, geographically constrained, and often rely on synthetic imagery, which hinders effective training and generalization. To overcome these limitations, we present AusSmoke, a new smoke segmentation dataset collected from Australia to address the data scarcity in this region. Furthermore, we introduce a MultiNational geographically diverse and substantially larger fully-labelled benchmark, called MultiNatSmoke, that consolidates publicly available international datasets with the newly collected Australian imagery, expanding the scale by an order of magnitude over previous collections. Finally, we benchmark smoke segmentation models, demonstrating improved performance and enhanced generalization across diverse geographical contexts. The project is available at \href{https://github.com/henryzhao0615/MultiNatSmoke}{Github}.

AI.tldr: 针对现有野火烟雾分割数据集规模小、地域局限、依赖合成图像的问题，本文提出了澳大利亚真实烟雾分割数据集AusSmoke，并整合多国公开数据构建了大规模基准数据集MultiNatSmoke，实验表明该数据集能提升模型性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的野火烟雾分割数据集规模有限、地理覆盖范围窄，且多依赖合成图像，导致模型训练效果差、泛化能力不足。特别是在澳大利亚等地区，真实烟雾数据极度匮乏，亟需高质量的真实世界数据集来推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 1）收集澳大利亚地区的真实烟雾图像，构建AusSmoke数据集；2）整合多个国家公开的烟雾分割数据集，创建规模更大的多国基准数据集MultiNatSmoke（规模比以往数据集提升一个数量级）；3）在该数据集上对烟雾分割模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 提出的MultiNatSmoke数据集规模比以往数据集扩大了一个数量级；在该数据集上训练的烟雾分割模型性能得到提升，并且在跨不同地理区域的泛化能力显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入来自澳大利亚的真实数据以及构建大规模多国基准数据集，有效解决了现有数据集规模小和地域局限的问题，显著提升了烟雾分割模型的性能和地理泛化能力，为野火早期检测提供了更有力的数据支撑。

title: DepthKV: Layer-Dependent KV Cache Pruning for Long-Context LLM Inference
summary: Long-context reasoning is a critical capability of large language models (LLMs), enabling applications such as long-document understanding, summarization, and code generation. However, efficient autoregressive inference relies on the key-value (KV) cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length, leading to a major memory bottleneck. To mitigate this overhead, KV cache pruning methods discard cached tokens with low attention scores during inference. Most existing methods apply a uniform pruning ratio across layers, implicitly assuming that all layers contribute equally to overall model performance. We show that this assumption is suboptimal, as layers differ significantly in their sensitivity to pruning. We propose DepthKV, a layer-dependent pruning framework that allocates a fixed global KV budget across layers based on their sensitivity, rather than using a uniform allocation. Across multiple models and tasks, DepthKV consistently outperforms uniform pruning at the same global pruning ratio, demonstrating more effective utilization of the KV cache budget through layer-dependent allocation.

AI.tldr: 提出DepthKV框架，根据各层对剪枝的敏感性差异，为不同层分配不同的KV缓存预算，取代传统的统一剪枝比例，从而更高效地利用KV缓存。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存剪枝方法假设各层对剪枝的敏感度相同，采用统一剪枝比例，但这一假设是次优的，因为不同层对剪枝的敏感度存在显著差异。
AI.method: 提出DepthKV，一种层依赖的剪枝框架，根据各层对剪枝的敏感度，在全局KV预算固定的前提下，为不同层分配不同的剪枝比例，而非统一分配。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，DepthKV在相同全局剪枝比例下， consistently outperforms uniform pruning（持续优于统一剪枝），展现了更有效的KV缓存预算利用。
AI.conclusion: 层依赖的KV缓存分配策略优于统一分配，能更有效地利用缓存预算，提升长上下文推理性能。

title: COMO: Closed-Loop Optical Molecule Recognition with Minimum Risk Training
summary: Optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) translates molecular images into machine-readable representations like SMILES strings or molecular graphs, but remains challenging in real-world documents due to inexhaustible variations in chemical structures, shorthand conventions, and visual noise. Most existing deep-learning-based approaches rely on teacher forcing with token-level Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE). This training paradigm suffers from exposure bias, as models are trained under ground-truth prefixes but must condition on their own previous predictions during inference. Moreover, token-level MLE objectives hinder the optimization towards molecular-level evaluation criteria such as chemical validity and structural similarity. Here we introduce Minimum Risk Training (MRT) to OCSR and propose COMO (Closed-loop Optical Molecule recOgnition), a closed-loop framework that mitigates exposure bias by directly optimizing over molecule-level, non-differentiable objectives, by iteratively sampling and evaluating the model's own predictions. Experiments on ten benchmarks including synthetic and real-world chemical diagrams from patent and scientific literature demonstrate that COMO substantially outperforms existing rule-based and learning-based methods with less training data. Ablation studies further show that MRT is architecture-agnostic, demonstrating its potential for broad application to end-to-end OCSR systems.

AI.tldr: 提出COMO框架，通过最小风险训练（MRT）直接优化分子级目标（如化学有效性和结构相似性），缓解曝光偏差问题，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有OCSR方法使用教师强制和token级MLE训练，存在曝光偏差（训练与推理的输入分布不一致）且无法直接优化分子级评价指标（如化学有效性、结构相似性）。
AI.method: 提出COMO框架，采用闭环训练策略：将最小风险训练（MRT）引入OCSR，通过对模型自身预测进行迭代采样和评估，直接优化不可微的分子级目标。
AI.result: 在10个基准（含合成图、专利及科学文献中的真实化学图）上，COMO以更少训练数据显著优于现有基于规则和基于学习的方法。
AI.conclusion: MRT具有架构无关性，可广泛应用于端到端OCSR系统。

title: Benchmarking Source-Sensitive Reasoning in Turkish: Humans and LLMs under Evidential Trust Manipulation
comment: Accepted to The 15th edition of the Workshop on Cognitive Modeling and Computational Linguistics, co-located with the Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
summary: This paper investigates whether source trustworthiness shapes Turkish evidential morphology and whether large language models (LLMs) track this sensitivity. We study the past-domain contrast between -DI and -mIs in controlled cloze contexts where the information source is overtly external, while only its perceived reliability is manipulated (High-Trust vs. Low-Trust). In a human production experiment, native speakers of Turkish show a robust trust effect: High-Trust contexts yield relatively more -DI, whereas Low-Trust contexts yield relatively more -mIs, with the pattern remaining stable across sensitivity analyses. We then evaluate 10 LLMs in three prompting paradigms (open gap-fill, explicit past-tense gap-fill, and forced-choice A/B selection). LLM behavior is highly model- and prompt-dependent: some models show weak or local trust-consistent shifts, but effects are generally unstable, often reversed, and frequently overshadowed by output-compliance problems and strong base-rate suffix preferences. The results provide new evidence for a trust-/commitment-based account of Turkish evidentiality and reveal a clear human-LLM gap in source-sensitive evidential reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验了信息来源可信度是否影响土耳其语的证据形态（-DI vs. -mIs），以及大语言模型（LLMs）能否捕捉这种敏感性。人类实验显示显著信任效应，而LLMs表现高度不稳定，存在明显的人机差距。
AI.motivation: 探究信息来源可信度对土耳其语证据形态的塑造作用，并检验大语言模型是否具备与人类相似的源敏感证据推理能力。
AI.method: 通过控制信息源可信度（高信任 vs. 低信任）进行人类受试产出实验，并在三种提示范式下评估10种LLM的表现。
AI.result: 人类表现出稳健的信任效应；LLM行为高度依赖模型和提示方式，效果不稳定且常出现反转或输出合规性问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究为土耳其语证据形态的信任/承诺解释提供了新证据，并揭示了人类与LLM在源敏感证据推理上的显著差距。

title: Spatiotemporal Degradation-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for Realistic Underwater Scene Reconstruction
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Author version of the paper published in Proceedings of ACM Multimedia 2025
summary: Reconstructing realistic underwater scenes from underwater video remains a meaningful yet challenging task in the multimedia domain. The inherent spatiotemporal degradations in underwater imaging, including caustics, flickering, attenuation, and backscattering, frequently result in inaccurate geometry and appearance in existing 3D reconstruction methods. While a few recent works have explored underwater degradation-aware reconstruction, they often address either spatial or temporal degradation alone, falling short in more real-world underwater scenarios where both types of degradation occur. We propose MarineSTD-GS, a novel 3D Gaussian Splatting-based framework that explicitly models both temporal and spatial degradations for realistic underwater scene reconstruction. Specifically, we introduce two paired Gaussian primitives: Intrinsic Gaussians represent the true scene, while Degraded Gaussians render the degraded observations. The color of each Degraded Gaussian is physically derived from its paired Intrinsic Gaussian via a Spatiotemporal Degradation Modeling (SDM) module, enabling self-supervised disentanglement of realistic appearance from degraded images. To ensure stable training and accurate geometry, we further propose a Depth-Guided Geometry Loss and a Multi-Stage Optimization strategy. We also construct a simulated benchmark with diverse spatial and temporal degradations and ground-truth appearances for comprehensive evaluation. Experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets show that MarineSTD-GS robustly handles spatiotemporal degradations and outperforms existing methods in novel view synthesis with realistic, water-free scene appearances.

AI.tldr: MarineSTD-GS提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅的框架，通过显式建模时空退化实现水下真实场景重建，在合成和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有水下3D重建方法未能同时处理空间退化（如衰减、反向散射）和时间退化（如焦散、闪烁），导致在真实水下场景中几何和外观重建不准确。
AI.method: 提出MarineSTD-GS框架，引入成对的本质高斯和退化高斯基元，通过时空退化建模模块从物理上推导退化高斯的颜色，实现自监督的真实外观解耦；并设计了深度引导几何损失和多阶段优化策略。
AI.result: 在合成和真实水下数据集上，MarineSTD-GS在鲁棒处理时空退化方面优于现有方法，在新视角合成中生成真实、无水的场景外观。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式联合建模时空退化，MarineSTD-GS有效解决了水下场景重建中的核心难题，为实际水下多媒体应用提供了可行方案。

title: Can LLMs Act as Historians? Evaluating Historical Research Capabilities of LLMs via the Chinese Imperial Examination
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have increasingly assisted in historical tasks such as text processing, their capacity for professional-level historical reasoning remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks primarily assess basic knowledge breadth or lexical understanding, failing to capture the higher-order skills, such as evidentiary reasoning,that are central to historical research. To fill this gap, we introduce ProHist-Bench, a novel benchmark anchored in the Chinese Imperial Examination (Keju) system, a comprehensive microcosm of East Asian political, social, and intellectual history spanning over 1,300 years. Developed through deep interdisciplinary collaboration, ProHist-Bench features 400 challenging, expert-curated questions across eight dynasties, accompanied by 10,891 fine-grained evaluation rubrics. Through a rigorous evaluation of 18 LLMs, we reveal a significant proficiency gap: even state-of-the-art LLMs struggle with complex historical research questions. We hope ProHist-Bench will facilitate the development of domain-specific reasoning LLMs, advance computational historical research, and further uncover the untapped potential of LLMs. We release ProHist-Bench at https://github.com/inclusionAI/ABench/tree/main/ProHist-Bench.

AI.tldr: ProHist-Bench是一个基于中国科举制度构建的专业历史推理基准，包含400道专家精选问题和10,891个细粒度评估标准，用于评估大语言模型在复杂历史研究任务中的高阶推理能力。评估发现，即使最先进的LLM在处理复杂历史研究问题时也存在显著能力差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法评估LLM在历史研究中所需的高阶技能（如证据推理），需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于中国科举制度（跨越1,300余年、涵盖八个朝代）构建了包含400道专家精选问题和10,891个细粒度评估标准的基准ProHist-Bench，并对18个LLM进行了严格评估。
AI.result: 即使最先进的LLM在处理复杂历史研究问题时也表现出显著的能力差距。
AI.conclusion: ProHist-Bench将促进领域特定推理LLM的发展、推动计算历史研究，并进一步揭示LLM的未开发潜力。

title: PhysLayer: Language-Guided Layered Animation with Depth-Aware Physics
summary: Existing image-to-video generation methods often produce physically implausible motions and lack precise control over object dynamics. While prior approaches have incorporated physics simulators, they remain confined to 2D planar motions and fail to capture depth-aware spatial interactions. We introduce PhysLayer, a novel framework enabling language-guided, depth-aware layered animation of static images. PhysLayer consists of three key components: First, a language-guided scene understanding module that utilizes vision foundation models to decompose scenes into depth-based layers by analyzing object composition, material properties, and physical parameters. Second, a depth-aware layered physics simulation that extends 2D rigid-body dynamics with depth motion and perspective-consistent scaling, enabling more realistic object interactions without requiring full 3D reconstruction. Third, a physics-guided video synthesis module that integrates simulated trajectories with scene-aware relighting for temporally coherent results. Experimental results demonstrate improvements in CLIP-Similarity (+2.2\%), FID score (+9.3\%), and Motion-FID (+3\%), with human evaluation showing enhanced physical plausibility (+24\%) and text-video alignment (+35\%). Our approach provides a practical balance between physical realism and computational efficiency for controllable image animation.

AI.tldr: PhysLayer是一个语言引导、深度感知的静态图像分层动画框架，通过结合视觉基础模型、深度感知物理模拟和物理引导视频合成，实现了比现有方法更真实、可控的图像到视频生成，在多项指标上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到视频生成方法常产生物理上不合理的运动，且缺乏对物体动力学的精确控制。虽然已有方法引入物理模拟器，但局限于2D平面运动，无法捕捉深度感知的空间交互。
AI.method: PhysLayer包含三个关键组件：1) 语言引导的场景理解模块，利用视觉基础模型根据物体组成、材质属性和物理参数将场景分解为深度分层；2) 深度感知的分层物理模拟，将2D刚体动力学扩展到深度运动和透视一致性缩放；3) 物理引导的视频合成模块，将模拟轨迹与场景感知重照明相结合。
AI.result: CLIP-Similarity提升2.2%，FID提升9.3%，Motion-FID提升3%。人工评估显示物理合理性提升24%，文本-视频对齐提升35%。
AI.conclusion: PhysLayer在物理真实感和计算效率之间取得了实际平衡，为可控图像动画提供了有效方案。

title: Contextual Linear Activation Steering of Language Models
summary: Linear activation steering is a powerful approach for eliciting the capabilities of large language models and specializing their behavior using limited labeled data. While effective, existing methods often apply a fixed steering strength to all tokens, resulting in inconsistent steering quality across diverse input prompts. In this work, we introduce Contextual Linear Activation Steering (CLAS), a method that dynamically adapts linear activation steering to context-dependent steering strengths. Across eleven steering benchmarks and four model families, it consistently outperforms standard linear activation steering and matches or exceeds the performance of ReFT and LoRA in settings with limited labeled data. We therefore propose CLAS as a scalable, interpretable, and accurate method for specializing and steering large language models.

AI.tldr: 提出CLAS方法，通过动态调整线性激活强度，在有限标注数据下实现比标准线性激活、ReFT和LoRA更优或相当的大模型引导效果。
AI.motivation: 现有线性激活引导方法对所有词元使用固定的引导强度，导致不同输入提示下的引导质量不一致。
AI.method: 提出上下文线性激活引导（CLAS），根据上下文动态调整引导强度。
AI.result: 在11个引导基准和4个模型家族上，CLAS持续优于标准线性激活引导，匹配或超过ReFT和LoRA在有限标注数据下的表现。
AI.conclusion: CLAS是一种可扩展、可解释且准确的大语言模型引导方法。

title: Identity-Decoupled Anonymization for Visual Evidence in Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: ACM International Conference on Multimedia Retrieval 2026
summary: Multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation (MRAG) systems retrieve visual evidence from large image corpora to ground the responses of large multi-modal models, yet the retrieved images frequently contain human faces whose identities constitute sensitive personal information. Existing anonymization techniques that destroy the non-identity visual cues that downstream reasoning depends on or fail to provide principled privacy guarantees. We propose Identity-Decoupled MRAG, a framework that interposes a generative anonymization module between retrieval and generation. Our approach consists of three components: (i)a disentangled variational encoder that factorizes each face into an identity code and a spatially-structured attribute code, regularized by a mutual-information penalty and a gradient-based independence term; (ii)a manifold-aware rejection sampler that replaces the identity code with a synthetic one guaranteed to be both distinct from the original and realistic; and (iii)a conditional latent diffusion generator that synthesizes the anonymized face from the replacement identity and the preserved attributes, distilled into a latent consistency model for low-latency deployment. Privacy is enforced through a multi-oracle ensemble of face recognition models with a hinge-based loss that halts optimization once identity similarity drops below the impostor-regime threshold.

AI.tldr: 提出身份解耦的多模态检索增强生成框架，通过生成式匿名化模块在检索与生成之间插入，实现人脸身份隐私保护的同时保留非身份视觉特征用于下游推理。
AI.motivation: 现有MRAG系统检索的图像常含人脸，构成敏感隐私；已有匿名化技术要么破坏非身份视觉线索影响下游推理，要么缺乏严格的隐私保证。
AI.method: 提出三组件框架：(i)解耦变分编码器将人脸分解为身份码和空间属性码，受互信息惩罚和梯度独立项约束；(ii)流形感知拒绝采样器用合成身份码替换原始身份码；(iii)条件潜扩散生成器合成匿名化人脸，蒸馏为潜一致性模型实现低延迟部署。隐私通过多oracle人脸识别模型集成和铰链损失来强制保证。
AI.result: 通过多oracle集成和铰链损失，确保身份相似度降至冒名者阈值以下，实现有原则的隐私保护。
AI.conclusion: 在保留图像中非身份视觉信息的同时，提供可证明的人脸身份隐私保护，兼顾下游任务性能和隐私要求。

title: The Chameleon's Limit: Investigating Persona Collapse and Homogenization in Large Language Models
summary: Applications based on large language models (LLMs), such as multi-agent simulations, require population diversity among agents. We identify a pervasive failure mode we term \emph{Persona Collapse}: agents each assigned a distinct profile nonetheless converge into a narrow behavioral mode, producing a homogeneous simulated population. To quantify persona collapse, we propose a framework that measures how much of the persona space a population occupies (Coverage), how evenly agents spread across it (Uniformity), and how rich the resulting behavioral patterns are (Complexity). Evaluating ten LLMs on personality simulation (BFI-44), moral reasoning, and self-introduction, we observe persona collapse along two axes: (1) Dimensions: a model can appear diverse on one axis yet structurally degenerate on another, and (2) Domains: the same model may collapse the most in personality yet be the most diverse in moral reasoning. Furthermore, item-level diagnostics reveal that behavioral variation tracks coarse demographic stereotypes rather than the fine-grained individual differences specified in each persona. Counter-intuitively, \textbf{the models achieving the highest per-persona fidelity consistently produce the most stereotyped populations}. We release our toolkit and data to support population-level evaluation of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文发现并量化了LLM多智能体模拟中的“角色崩溃”现象：分配不同角色的智能体会收敛到同质化行为模式。评估了10个LLM在三个维度上的表现，发现模型在高保真度下反而产生最刻板化的群体行为。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的多智能体模拟需要群体多样性，但现有研究缺乏对智能体行为同质化问题的系统量化与诊断。
AI.method: 提出覆盖度(Coverage)、均匀度(Uniformity)和复杂度(Complexity)三维框架，在人格模拟、道德推理和自我简介三个领域评估10个LLM的角色崩溃程度。
AI.result: 发现角色崩溃沿两个轴发生：(1)维度轴：模型在某个维度上多样但另一维度退化为同质；(2)领域轴：同一模型在人格任务中最差但在道德推理中多样。行为变异更多反映粗粒度人口刻板印象而非细粒度个体差异。反直觉的是，单角色保真度最高的模型产生的群体最刻板。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在生成多样化群体行为方面存在系统性缺陷，高保真度反而导致刻板印象加剧，需要新的群体级评估方法。

title: Talker-T2AV: Joint Talking Audio-Video Generation with Autoregressive Diffusion Modeling
summary: Joint audio-video generation models have shown that unified generation yields stronger cross-modal coherence than cascaded approaches. However, existing models couple modalities throughout denoising via pervasive attention, treating high-level semantics and low-level details in a fully entangled manner. This is suboptimal for talking head synthesis: while audio and facial motion are semantically correlated, their low-level realizations (acoustic signals and visual textures) follow distinct rendering processes. Enforcing joint modeling across all levels causes unnecessary entanglement and reduces efficiency. We propose Talker-T2AV, an autoregressive diffusion framework where high-level cross-modal modeling occurs in a shared backbone, while low-level refinement uses modality-specific decoders. A shared autoregressive language model jointly reasons over audio and video in a unified patch-level token space. Two lightweight diffusion transformer heads decode the hidden states into frame-level audio and video latents. Experiments on talking portrait benchmarks show Talker-T2AV outperforms dual-branch baselines in lip-sync accuracy, video quality, and audio quality, achieving stronger cross-modal consistency than cascaded pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出Talker-T2AV，一个自回归扩散框架，通过共享主干进行高层跨模态建模，并利用模态特定解码器进行低层细化，在说话头生成任务中优于级联和双分支方法。
AI.motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型在所有层级上耦合模态，导致高层语义与低层细节过度纠缠，效率低下，不适用于说话头合成中音频与面部运动语义相关但低层实现遵循不同渲染过程的特点。
AI.method: 提出Talker-T2AV框架：1）共享自回归语言模型在统一patch级token空间联合推理音频和视频；2）两个轻量级扩散Transformer头将隐藏状态解码为帧级音频和视频潜变量，实现高层跨模态建模共享主干、低层细化使用模态特定解码器的分离架构。
AI.result: 在说话人肖像基准上，Talker-T2AV在唇音同步精度、视频质量和音频质量方面均优于双分支基线，实现了比级联流水线更强的跨模态一致性。
AI.conclusion: 高层语义与低层细节解耦的联合生成架构在说话头合成任务中更优，共享主干+模态特定解码器的设计平衡了跨模态一致性与生成效率。

title: Long-Context Aware Upcycling: A New Frontier for Hybrid LLM Scaling
summary: Hybrid sequence models that combine efficient Transformer components with linear sequence modeling blocks are a promising alternative to pure Transformers, but most are still pretrained from scratch and therefore fail to reuse existing Transformer checkpoints. We study upcycling as a practical path to convert pretrained Transformer LLMs into hybrid architectures while preserving short-context quality and improving long-context capability. We call our solution \emph{HyLo} (HYbrid LOng-context): a long-context upcycling recipe that combines architectural adaptation with efficient Transformer blocks, Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), and linear blocks (Mamba2 or Gated DeltaNet), together with staged long-context training and teacher-guided distillation for stable optimization. HyLo extends usable context length by up to $32\times$ through efficient post-training and reduces KV-cache memory by more than $90\%$, enabling up to 2M-token prefill and decoding in our \texttt{vLLM} inference stack, while comparable Llama baselines run out of memory beyond 64K context. Across 1B- and 3B-scale settings (Llama- and Qwen-based variants), HyLo delivers consistently strong short- and long-context performance and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art upcycled hybrid baselines on long-context evaluations such as RULER. Notably, at similar scale, HyLo-Qwen-1.7B trained on only 10B tokens significantly outperforms JetNemotron (trained on 400B tokens) on GSM8K, Lm-Harness common sense reasoning and RULER-64K.

AI.tldr: 提出HyLo方法，通过升级改造将预训练Transformer大模型转化为混合架构（结合MLA、Mamba2等线性模块），在保持短上下文质量的同时将有效上下文长度扩展32倍，KV缓存减少90%以上，支持2M token推理，仅用10B训练数据即可超越400B训练的基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有混合序列模型大多需要从头预训练，无法复用已有的高性能Transformer检查点，造成计算资源浪费；同时纯Transformer在处理超长上下文时存在KV缓存内存瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出HyLo升级方案：1）架构适配：在Transformer中集成高效模块（MLA）和线性序列建模块（Mamba2或Gated DeltaNet）；2）分阶段长上下文训练；3）教师引导蒸馏以稳定优化过程。
AI.result: 有效上下文长度扩展32倍，KV缓存内存减少90%以上，支持2M token预填和解码；在1B和3B规模（Llama和Qwen变体）下，长短上下文性能均优于现有升级混合基线；HyLo-Qwen-1.7B仅用10B训练数据即超越JetNemotron（400B数据）的GSM8K、常识推理和RULER-64K性能。
AI.conclusion: HyLo是一种实用且高效的预训练Transformer升级路径，能在不牺牲短上下文质量的前提下显著提升长上下文能力，且训练效率极高。

title: A Synergistic CNN-Transformer Network with Pooling Attention Fusion for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: In the hyperspectral image (HSI) classification task, each pixel is categorized into a specific land-cover category or material. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers have been widely used to extract local and non-local features in HSI classification. Recent works have utilized a multi-scale vision transformer (ViT) to enhance spectral feature capture and yield promising results. However, most existing methods still face challenges in the effective joint use of spatial-spectral information and in preserving information across layers during the propagation process. To address these issues, we propose a synergistic CNN-Transformer network with pooling attention fusion for HSI classification, which collaboratively utilizes CNNs and ViT to process spatial and spectral features separately. Specifically, we propose a Twin-Branch Feature Extraction (TBFE) module, which employs 3D and 2D convolution in parallel to comprehensively extract spectral and spatial features from HSI. A hybrid pooling attention (HPA) module is designed to aggregate spatial attention. Moreover, a cascade transformer encoder is employed for global spectral feature extraction, and a simple yet efficient cross-layer feature fusion (CFF) module is designed to reduce the loss of crucial information in the previous network layers. Extensive experiments are conducted on several representative datasets to demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed method compared to the state-of-the-art works. Code is available at https://github.com/chenpeng052/SCT-Net.git.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种协同CNN-Transformer网络（SCT-Net），通过双分支特征提取、混合池化注意力、级联Transformer编码器和跨层特征融合模块，有效解决了高光谱图像分类中空间-光谱信息联合利用和层间信息保留问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在联合使用空间-光谱信息以及在传播过程中保留层间信息方面仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 1) 双分支特征提取（TBFE）模块：并行使用3D和2D卷积分别提取光谱和空间特征；2) 混合池化注意力（HPA）模块：聚合空间注意力；3) 级联Transformer编码器：提取全局光谱特征；4) 跨层特征融合（CFF）模块：减少前层关键信息丢失。
AI.result: 在多个代表性数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的SCT-Net通过CNN与Transformer的协同以及跨层融合机制，有效提升了高光谱图像分类性能。

title: Discriminator-Guided Adaptive Diffusion for Source-Free Test-Time Adaptation under Image Corruptions
comment: This is the preprint (submitted version) of the paper. The final version has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026)
summary: In this work, we study Source-Free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation under corruption-induced domain shifts, where performance degradation is caused by natural image corruptions that go beyond additive noise, including blur, weather effects, and digital artifacts. We propose a diffusion-based, input-level adaptation framework that operates entirely at test time and keeps all source-trained models frozen, explicitly targeting robustness to corrupted target inputs. Our method leverages a source-trained diffusion model as a generative prior and introduces a discriminator-guided adaptive diffusion strategy that dynamically controls the amount of perturbation applied to each test sample. Rather than relying on a fixed diffusion depth, the discriminator determines, on a per-image basis, when sufficient forward diffusion has been applied to suppress corruption-specific artifacts, with each corruption type effectively defining a distinct target domain. This adaptive stopping mechanism applies only the necessary amount of noise to remove domainspecific corruption while preserving class-discriminative structure. The reverse diffusion process then reconstructs a source-aligned image, optionally stabilized through structural guidance, which is classified using a frozen source-trained classifier. We evaluate the proposed approach across a broad spectrum of corruption-induced target domains, covering 15 diverse corruption types, and demonstrate more balanced robustness with competitive or improved performance across non-noise corruptions. Additional analyses reveal how the adaptive diffusion schedule responds to different corruption characteristics, highlighting the practicality, generality, and robustness of the proposed framework. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/fmolivato/dgadiffusion/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的测试时输入级自适应框架，用于解决由自然图像退化（如模糊、天气效果、数字伪影等）引起的源域无关无监督域适应问题。该方法利用源域训练的扩散模型作为生成先验，通过判别器引导的自适应扩散策略，动态决定每个测试样本所需的前向扩散步数以抑制退化伪影，再通过反向扩散重建与源域对齐的图像，最终由冻结的源域分类器进行分类。在15种退化类型上验证了方法的鲁棒性和泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理超出加性噪声的自然图像退化（如模糊、天气效果、数字伪影）时性能显著下降，需要一种能在测试时有效抑制各类退化的输入级自适应方法。
AI.method: 提出判别器引导的自适应扩散策略（DGA-Diffusion），利用源域训练的扩散模型作为生成先验，通过判别器逐图像判断前向扩散是否已充分抑制退化伪影，再通过反向扩散重建源域对齐图像，并可选结构引导稳定重建过程。
AI.result: 在15种退化类型上展示了更均衡的鲁棒性，在非噪声退化上取得具有竞争力或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 自适应扩散调度能有效响应不同退化特征，该框架具有实用性、泛化性和鲁棒性。

title: VDLF-Net: Variational Feature Fusion for Adaptive and Few-Shot Visual Learning
summary: This paper introduces VDLF-Net, which attaches a compact VAE to a multi-scale CNN backbone. Latent vectors and softmax-gate support the backbone feature maps, while $\ell_2$-normalized embeddings from the gated maps contribute toward supervised classification or episodic few-shot prediction. Under standard CIFAR-100 and Mini-ImageNet protocols, VDLF-Net demonstrates an improved performance over ResNet-50 Enhanced, VGG-16, Prototypical Networks, and Matching Networks. Extensive ablations show that removing the fine-resolution scale has the greatest impact on VDLF-Net's performance. At the same time, KL and reconstruction at the chosen $α$ pose a minor performance reduction, demonstrating that performance gains over classical episodic baselines mainly originate from the full VDLF-Net architecture and training strategy.

AI.tldr: VDLF-Net通过将紧凑型VAE附加到多尺度CNN主干，结合潜在向量和softmax门控机制，在CIFAR-100和Mini-ImageNet上优于ResNet-50 Enhanced、VGG-16等基线模型。消融实验表明细分辨率尺度最关键，而KL和重建损失影响较小，性能提升主要来自完整架构和训练策略。
AI.motivation: 提升小样本学习和图像分类性能，探索VAE与CNN结合的有效性。
AI.method: 在CNN主干上附加紧凑VAE，利用潜在向量和softmax门控增强特征图，采用ℓ2归一化嵌入进行监督分类或小样本预测。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100和Mini-ImageNet上优于ResNet-50 Enhanced、VGG-16、Prototypical Networks和Matching Networks。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升主要归因于VDLF-Net的完整架构和训练策略，细分辨率尺度是关键因素，KL和重建损失影响较小。

title: RaV-IDP: A Reconstruction-as-Validation Framework for Faithful Intelligent Document Processing
summary:
Intelligent document processing pipelines extract structured entities (tables, images, and text) from documents for use in downstream systems such as knowledge bases, retrieval-augmented generation, and analytics. A persistent limitation of existing pipelines is that extraction output is produced without any intrinsic mechanism to verify whether it faithfully represents the source. Model-internal confidence scores measure inference certainty, not correspondence to the document, and extraction errors pass silently into downstream consumers.
  We present Reconstruction as Validation (RaV-IDP), a document processing pipeline that introduces reconstruction as a first-class architectural component. After each entity is extracted, a dedicated reconstructor renders the extracted representation back into a form comparable to the original document region, and a comparator scores fidelity between the reconstruction and the unmodified source crop. This fidelity score is a grounded, label-free quality signal. When fidelity falls below a per-entity-type threshold, a structured GPT-4.1 vision fallback is triggered and the validation loop repeats. We enforce a bootstrap constraint: the comparator always anchors against the original document region, never against the extraction, preventing the validation from becoming circular.
  We further propose a per-stage evaluation framework pairing each pipeline component with an appropriate benchmark. The code pipeline is publicly available at https://github.com/pritesh-2711/RaV-IDP for experimentation and use.

AI.tldr: 提出RaV-IDP，通过重构验证机制为文档实体提取提供内置质量信号，并引入GPT-4.1视觉回退策略。
AI.motivation: 现有文档处理管线无法验证提取结果是否忠实于源文档，置信度分数无法衡量与文档的一致性，提取错误会无声传递到下游系统。
AI.method: 提出RaV-IDP框架：提取实体后由专用重构器生成可对比的重构结果，比较器计算重构与原始文档区域之间的保真度分数；低于阈值时触发GPT-4.1视觉回退并循环验证；比较器始终锚定原始文档区域，防止循环验证。
AI.result: 提出一种无需标签的保真度质量信号，并建立分阶段评估框架，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 重构验证机制为文档智能处理提供了有效的质量保障手段，未来可广泛应用于知识库、RAG等下游系统。

title: Geometry-Conditioned Diffusion for Occlusion-Robust In-Bed Pose Estimation
comment: This is the preprint version of the paper. The final version has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 20th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (IEEE FG 2026)
summary: Robust in-bed human pose estimation under blanket occlusion remains challenging due to the scarcity of reliable labeled training data for heavily covered poses. Existing approaches rely on multi-modal sensing or image-to-image translation frameworks that remain conditioned on visible source imagery, limiting scalability and pose diversity. In this work, we reformulate occlusion-aware augmentation as a geometry-conditioned generative modeling task. We conduct a systematic comparison of deterministic masking, unpaired translation, paired diffusion-based translation, and a proposed pose-conditioned Latent Diffusion Model (Pose-LDM). Unlike image-guided methods, Pose-LDM synthesizes blanket-covered images directly from skeletal keypoints, eliminating dependence on paired supervision and pixel-level source-image conditioning while enabling generation from arbitrary pose inputs. All augmentation strategies are evaluated through their impact on downstream pose estimation under a fixed backbone. Pose- LDM achieves the highest strict localization accuracy under severe occlusion while maintaining overall detection performance comparable to paired diffusion models, approaching the performance of fully supervised training. These results demonstrate that geometry-conditioned diffusion provides an effective and supervision-efficient pathway toward occlusion-robust inbed pose estimation without modifying the sensing pipeline. The code is available at: github.com/navidTerraNova/ GeoDiffPose.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于几何条件的扩散模型Pose-LDM，通过从骨骼关键点直接生成被子遮挡图像，有效解决了床上人体姿态估计中遮挡标注数据稀缺的问题，在严重遮挡下实现了高精度姿态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖多模态传感或图像翻译框架，受限于可见源图像条件，可扩展性和姿态多样性不足；且缺乏可靠的遮挡姿态标注数据。
AI.method: 将遮挡感知增强重构为几何条件生成建模任务，系统比较了确定性掩码、非配对翻译、配对扩散翻译和提出的姿态条件潜扩散模型（Pose-LDM）。Pose-LDM直接从骨骼关键点合成被子覆盖图像，无需配对监督和像素级源图像条件。
AI.result: Pose-LDM在严重遮挡下取得了最高严格定位精度，整体检测性能与配对扩散模型相当，接近全监督训练水平。
AI.conclusion: 几何条件扩散为遮挡鲁棒的床上姿态估计提供了一条无需修改传感管线的有效且监督高效的路径。

title: ResAF-Net: An Anchor-Free Attention-Based Network for Tree Detection and Agricultural Mapping in Palestine
summary: Reliable agricultural data is essential for food security, land-use planning, and economic resilience, yet in Palestine, such data remains difficult to collect at scale because of fragmented landscapes, limited field access, and restrictions on aerial monitoring. This paper presents ResAF-Net, a satellite-based tree detection framework designed for large-scale agricultural monitoring in resource-constrained settings. The proposed architecture combines a ResNet-50 encoder, Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP), a feature-fusion stage, a multi-head self-attention refinement module, and an anchor-free FCOS detection head to improve tree localization in dense and heterogeneous scenes. Trained on the MillionTrees benchmark, the model achieved 82% Recall, 63.03% mAP@0.50, and 35.47% mAP@0.50:0.95 on the validation split, indicating strong sensitivity to tree presence while maintaining competitive localization quality. Beyond benchmark evaluation, we implemented the model within a web-based GIS application integrated with Palestinian cadastral data from GeoMolg, enabling tree analysis at scene, parcel, and community levels. This deployment demonstrates the practical feasibility of AI-assisted agricultural inventorying in Palestine. It provides a foundation for data-driven monitoring, reporting, and future species-level analysis of Mediterranean tree crops.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResAF-Net，一种基于卫星图像的大规模农业树木检测框架，在巴勒斯坦资源受限环境中实现了82%召回率和63.03% mAP@0.50，并集成到GIS应用中实现三级分析。
AI.motivation: 巴勒斯坦地区由于景观碎片化、实地访问受限和空中监测限制，难以大规模获取可靠的农业数据，影响粮食安全、土地利用规划和经济韧性。
AI.method: 提出ResAF-Net框架，结合ResNet-50编码器、空洞空间金字塔池化（ASPP）、特征融合阶段、多头自注意力精炼模块和无锚框FCOS检测头，在MillionTrees基准上训练，并集成到基于Web的GIS应用中。
AI.result: 在验证集上达到82%召回率、63.03% mAP@0.50和35.47% mAP@0.50:0.95，展示了强灵敏度与竞争力定位质量。实际部署支持场景、地块和社区三级分析。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在巴勒斯坦证明了AI辅助农业清点的实际可行性，为数据驱动的监测、报告及未来地中海树木作物的物种级分析奠定基础。

title: BVI-Mamba: Video Enhancement Using a Visual State-Space Model for Low-Light and Underwater Environments
summary: Videos captured in low-light and underwater conditions often suffer from distortions such as noise, low contrast, color imbalance, and blur. These issues not only limit visibility but also degrade automatic tasks like detection. Post-processing is typically required but can be time-consuming. AI-based tools for video enhancement also demand significantly more computational resources compared to image-based methods. This paper introduces a novel framework, Visual Mamba, designed to reduce memory usage and computational time by leveraging the Visual State Space (VSS) model. The framework consists of two modules: (i) a feature alignment module, where spatio-temporal displacement between input frames is registered in the feature space, and (ii) an enhancement module, where noise removal and brightness adjustment are performed using a UNet-like architecture, with all convolutional layers replaced by VSS blocks. Experimental results show that the Visual Mamba technique outperforms Transformer and convolution-based models in both low-light and underwater video enhancement tasks. Code is available on line at https://github.com/russellllaputa/BVI-Mamba.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Visual Mamba框架，基于视觉状态空间（VSS）模型，通过特征对齐和增强两个模块，在低光和水下视频增强任务中降低内存和计算开销，性能优于Transformer和卷积模型。
AI.motivation: 低光和水下视频存在噪声、低对比度、色彩失衡和模糊等问题，影响视觉效果和下游任务。现有AI增强方法计算资源消耗大，需要更高效的视频增强框架。
AI.method: 提出Visual Mamba框架，包含两个模块：(1) 特征对齐模块——在特征空间中注册输入帧之间的时空位移；(2) 增强模块——采用UNet-like架构，将所有卷积层替换为VSS块，进行去噪和亮度调整。
AI.result: Visual Mamba在低光和水下视频增强任务中，性能优于Transformer和基于卷积的模型，同时降低了内存使用和计算时间。
AI.conclusion: Visual Mamba作为一种基于VSS的高效视频增强框架，在减少资源消耗的同时取得了优于主流模型的增强效果，代码已开源。

title: SolarFCD: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Solar Fault Classification in Photovoltaic Systems
summary: The increasing global deployment of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems needs robust, scalable, and automated inspection technologies capable of detecting a wide range of panel flaws under a variety of operating situations. The lack of large-scale, multi-modal, publicly available annotated datasets is a major obstacle preventing advancement in this field. We introduce SolarFCD, an extensive dataset of solar panel defects created by methodically combining and reconciling three publicly accessible datasets covering two imaging modalities: RGB/Drone images and Thermal Infrared. The dataset consist of 4,435 images arranged under four unified defect classes such as: healthy images, Surface Obstruction, structural fault, and electrical fault. The dataset was divided into training, validation, and test splits at an 80:10:10 ratio through methodical label mapping, near-duplicate removal, and targeted augmentation of minority classes. Sixteen classification architectures from five design families were trained and assessed on the dataset to provide repeatable benchmark baselines. With an accuracy of 86.68%, precision of 88.65%, recall of 88.62%, and F1-score of 88.17%, ResNet101V2 performed the best overall. Per-class results showed balanced detection across all four defect categories within a narrow performance band of less than 1.2 percentage points. To promote open and repeatable research in automated PV inspection and solar energy operations and maintenance, the dataset, annotation files, and baseline code are made openly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SolarFCD——一个融合RGB/无人机和热红外两种成像模态的太阳能电池板缺陷数据集，包含4,435张图像和四类统一缺陷标签。通过系统评估16种分类架构，ResNet101V2取得了最优性能（准确率86.68%，F1分数88.17%），数据集和代码已开源以推动光伏自动化检测研究。
AI.motivation: 当前光伏系统大规模部署需要自动化检测技术，但缺乏大规模、多模态、公开标注的数据集是主要障碍，因此亟需构建统一标准的数据集以推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 整合三个公开数据集（RGB/无人机和热红外两种模态），经过标签映射、近重复去除和少数类增强处理后得到4,435张图像，按80:10:10划分训练/验证/测试集，并在五个设计家族的16种分类架构上建立基准。
AI.result: ResNet101V2表现最佳：准确率86.68%，精确率88.65%，召回率88.62%，F1分数88.17%。四个缺陷类别性能差异小于1.2个百分点，检测均衡性好。
AI.conclusion: SolarFCD数据集和基线结果验证了多模态融合在光伏缺陷检测中的有效性，开源资源将促进该领域的可重复研究和工程应用。

title: HAC: Parameter-Efficient Hyperbolic Adaptation of CLIP for Zero-Shot VQA
comment: This is the preprint version of the paper. The final version has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026)
summary: Recent advances in representation learning have shown that hyperbolic geometry can offer a more expressive alternative to the Euclidean embeddings used in CLIP models, capturing hierarchical structures and leading to better-organized representations. However, current hyperbolic CLIP variants are trained entirely from scratch, which is computationally expensive and resource-intensive. In this work, we propose HAC (Hyperbolic Adaptation of CLIP), a parameter-efficient framework that enables pretrained CLIP models to transition into hyperbolic space via lightweight fine-tuning. We apply HAC to Visual Question Answering (VQA), where models must interpret visual elements and align them with textual queries. Notably, HAC's training is performed on a dataset with no overlap with any VQA benchmark, resulting in a strict zero-shot evaluation paradigm that underscores HAC's task-agnostic adaptability. We evaluate HAC across a diverse suite of VQA benchmarks spanning General, Reasoning, and OCR categories. Both HAC-S (small) and HAC-B (medium) consistently surpass Euclidean baselines and prior hyperbolic approaches, with HAC-B delivering up to a +1.9 point average improvement over CLIP-B on reasoning-intensive tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/fdibiton/HAC

AI.tldr: 提出HAC框架，通过参数高效的微调将预训练CLIP模型转换到双曲空间，在VQA零样本任务上取得优于欧几里得基线和先前双曲方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有双曲CLIP变体需从头训练，计算开销大且资源密集；希望利用预训练CLIP模型，通过轻量微调实现向双曲空间的低成本迁移。
AI.method: 提出HAC（Hyperbolic Adaptation of CLIP），一种参数高效的微调框架，将预训练CLIP模型适应到双曲空间；在无VQA重叠的数据集上训练，实现严格零样本评估。
AI.result: HAC-S和HAC-B在通用、推理和OCR类VQA基准上均超越欧几里得基线和先前双曲方法；HAC-B在推理密集型任务上比CLIP-B平均提升+1.9个点。
AI.conclusion: HAC证明了通过参数高效微调将预训练CLIP迁移至双曲空间的可行性，为节省计算资源的同时利用双曲几何优势提供了新路径。

title: Deploy DINO with Many-to-Many Association
summary: Motivated by the limited generalization of supervised image matching models to unseen image domains, we explore the zero-shot deployment of DINO features for this task. The generalist visual representation extracted from DINO has inherent ambiguity when used to match feature points among semantically similar instances, prompting us to adopt a many-to-many (m-to-m) matching paradigm. However, the existing robust mechanism under m-to-m data association is computationally heavy, which requires finding a maximum-cardinality matching in the inlier association graph for each parameter evaluation. To address this inefficiency, we introduce a novel likelihood perspective, which interprets the existing method as a zeroth-order approximation of otherwise intractable likelihood calculation,and inspires us to propose a faster and finer-grained robust mechanism, termed as Harmonic Consensus Maximization (HCM). Take camera pose estimation as an exemplifying downstream task, we demonstrate that general-purpose visual features, used out of the box without any adaptation, can compete with specialized matching models on out-of-distribution datasets when mated with m-to-m association and the HCM mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用DINO特征进行零样本图像匹配，通过多对多匹配范式和谐波共识最大化（HCM）机制，在无需领域适应的条件下达到与专用匹配模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 监督图像匹配模型在未见图像域上泛化能力有限，亟需探索零样本部署方案。
AI.method: 采用DINO特征的零样本部署，引入多对多匹配范式，并提出谐波共识最大化（HCM）机制以解决原有多对多方法计算效率低的问题。
AI.result: 在相机位姿估计等下游任务中，通用视觉特征无需任何适应即可在域外数据集上与专用匹配模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: 多对多关联结合HCM机制能有效释放DINO特征在零样本图像匹配中的潜力。

title: Learning to Decipher from Pixels -- A Case Study of Copiale
summary: Historical encrypted manuscripts require both paleographic interpretation of cipher symbols and cryptanalytic recovery of plaintext. Most existing computational workflows rely on a transcription-first paradigm, in which handwritten symbols are transcribed prior to decipherment. This intermediate step is labor-intensive, error-prone, and not always aligned with the goal of direct plaintext recovery. We propose an end-to-end, transcription-free approach that directly maps handwritten cipher images to plaintext. Using the Copiale cipher as a case study, we introduce the first text-line-level dataset pairing cipher images with German plaintext. We show that pretraining on generic handwriting data followed by cipher-specific fine-tuning substantially improves decipherment accuracy. Our results demonstrate that transcription-free image-to-plaintext decipherment is both feasible and effective for historical substitution ciphers, offering a simplified and scalable alternative to traditional pipelines. https://github.com/leitro/Decipher-from-Pixels-Copiale

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无转录的端到端方法，直接从历史加密手稿图像映射到明文，以Copiale密码为例验证了其可行性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统工作流依赖先转录后解密，转录过程耗时费力且易错，与直接恢复明文的目标不一致。
AI.method: 构建首个文本行级别的密文图像与德语明文配对数据集，采用通用手写数据预训练+密码特定微调的策略，实现端到端的图像到明文映射。
AI.result: 无转录方法在历史替换密码上可行且有效，预训练+微调策略显著提升解密准确率。
AI.conclusion: 无转录图像到明文解密为传统流程提供了一种简化且可扩展的替代方案，降低了人工转录成本。

title: ShredBench: Evaluating the Semantic Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Document Reconstruction
comment: ACL 2026 Findings. Code available at https://github.com/ythere-y/ShredBench
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance in Visually Rich Document Understanding (VRDU) tasks, but their capabilities are mainly evaluated on pristine, well-structured document images. We consider content restoration from shredded fragments, a challenging VRDU setting that requires integrating visual pattern recognition with semantic reasoning under significant content discontinuities. To facilitate systematic evaluation of complex VRDU tasks, we introduce ShredBench, a benchmark supported by an automated generation pipeline that renders fragmented documents directly from Markdown. The proposed pipeline ensures evaluation validity by allowing the flexible integration of latest or unseen textual sources to prevent training data contamination. ShredBench assesses four scenarios (English, Chinese, Code, Table) with three fragmentation granularities (8, 12, 16 pieces). Empirical evaluations on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a significant performance gap: The method is effective on intact documents; however, once the document is shredded, restoration becomes a significant challenge, with NED dropping sharply as fragmentation increases. Our findings highlight that current MLLMs lack the fine-grained cross-modal reasoning required to bridge visual discontinuities, identifying a critical gap in robust VRDU research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ShredBench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在碎片文档恢复任务上的能力。实验表明，当前最先进的MLLMs在处理完整文档时表现良好，但面对碎片化文档时性能急剧下降，暴露出跨模态细粒度推理能力的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs评测主要基于完整、结构良好的文档图像，缺乏对碎片化文档恢复这一复杂VRDU任务的系统评估。为填补这一空白，作者设计了一个自动化生成管道来构建碎片化文档评测基准。
AI.method: 提出ShredBench，通过自动化生成管道直接从Markdown渲染碎片化文档，支持灵活集成最新文本源以防数据污染。包含英文、中文、代码、表格四种场景，设置8、12、16三种碎片化粒度。
AI.result: 在先进MLLMs上的实验显示，模型在完整文档上表现良好，但文档碎片化后恢复性能急剧下降，NED指标随碎片数量增加而显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLMs缺乏弥合视觉不连续性所需的细粒度跨模态推理能力，识别出鲁棒VRDU研究中的关键缺口。

title: Do Protective Perturbations Really Protect Portrait Privacy under Real-world Image Transformations?
summary: Proactive defense methods protect portrait images from unauthorized editing or talking face generation (TFG) by introducing pixel-level protective perturbations, and have already attracted increasing attention for privacy protection. In real-world scenarios, images inevitably undergo various transformations during cross-device display and dissemination--such as scale transformations and color compression--that directly alter pixel values. However, it remains unclear whether such pixel-level modifications affect the effectiveness of existing proactive defense methods that rely on pixel-level perturbations. To solve this problem, we conduct a systematic evaluation of representative proactive defenses under image transformation. The evaluated methods are selected to span different generation architectures such as diffusion and GAN-based models, as well as defense scopes covering both portrait and natural images, and are assessed using both qualitative and quantitative metrics for subjective and objective comparison. Experimental results indicate that defense methods based on pixel-level perturbations struggle to withstand common image transformations, posing a risk of defense failure in real-world applications. To further highlight this risk, we propose a simple yet effective purification framework by leveraging the vulnerabilities induced by real-world image transformations. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can efficiently remove protective perturbations with low computational cost, highlighting previously overlooked risks to the research community.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了现有基于像素级扰动的主动防御方法在真实场景图像变换（如缩放、颜色压缩）下的有效性，发现这些方法难以抵御常见变换导致防御失效，并提出了一种低计算成本的净化框架来移除保护性扰动，揭示了被忽视的安全风险。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中图像在跨设备显示和传播过程中不可避免地会经历各种变换（如缩放、颜色压缩），这些变换会直接改变像素值。目前尚不清楚这种像素级修改是否会影响依赖像素级扰动的主动防御方法的有效性，因此有必要进行系统评估。
AI.method: 1) 对涵盖扩散模型和GAN模型、肖像和自然图像等不同维度的代表性主动防御方法进行系统评估；2) 使用定性和定量指标进行主客观比较；3) 提出一个利用真实世界图像变换脆弱性的简单而有效的净化框架。
AI.result: 基于像素级扰动的防御方法难以抵抗常见的图像变换，存在实际应用中的防御失效风险；提出的净化方法能够以低计算成本有效移除保护性扰动。
AI.conclusion: 现有主动防御方法在真实场景图像变换下存在脆弱性，研究社区需要关注这一被忽视的风险。

title: DeepTaxon: An Interpretable Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Framework for Unified Species Identification and Discovery
summary: Identifying species in biology among tens of thousands of visually similar taxa while discovering unknown species in open-world environments remains a fundamental challenge in biodiversity research. Current methods treat identification and discovery as separate problems, with classification models assuming closed sets and discovery relying on threshold-based rejection. Here we present DeepTaxon, a retrieval-augmented multimodal framework that unifies species identification and discovery through interpretable reasoning over retrieved visual evidence. Given a query image, DeepTaxon retrieves the top-$k$ candidate species with $n$ exemplar images each from a retrieval index and performs chain-of-thought comparative reasoning. Critically, we redefine discovery as an explicit, retrieval-based decision problem rather than an implicit parametric memory problem. A sample is novel if and only if the retrieval index lacks sufficient evidence for identification, so each retrieval naturally yields a classification or discovery label without manual annotation, thereby providing automatic supervision for both tasks. We train the framework via supervised fine-tuning on synthetic retrieval-augmented data, followed by reinforcement learning on hard samples, converting high-recall retrieval into high-precision decisions that scale to massive taxonomic vocabularies. Extensive experiments on a large-scale in-distribution benchmark and six out-of-distribution datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in both identification and discovery. Ablation studies further reveal effective test-time scaling with candidate count $k$ and exemplar count $n$, strong zero-shot transfer to unseen domains, and consistent performance across retrieval encoders, establishing an interpretable solution for biodiversity research.

AI.tldr: DeepTaxon是一个检索增强的多模态框架，通过检索视觉证据和链式推理统一了物种识别与发现任务，将发现重新定义为显式的检索决策问题，并在大规模实验中取得了显著改进。
AI.motivation: 当前方法将物种识别与发现视为分离问题，分类模型假设封闭集，发现依赖基于阈值的拒绝机制，缺乏统一且可解释的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出DeepTaxon框架：1) 检索增强：从索引中检索top-k候选物种及其n个示例图像；2) 链式推理：对检索到的视觉证据进行可解释的比较推理；3) 将发现重新定义为检索决策问题；4) 通过监督微调（合成检索增强数据）+强化学习（难样本）进行训练。
AI.result: 在大规模分布内基准和六个分布外数据集上，识别与发现性能一致提升；消融实验表明有效测试时缩放、强零样本迁移能力以及跨检索编码器的一致性表现。
AI.conclusion: DeepTaxon建立了可解释的生物多样性研究解决方案，将高召回检索转化为高精度决策，能够扩展到大规模分类词汇表。

title: A Pose-only Geometric Constraint for Multi-Camera Pose Adjustment
summary: Multi-camera systems offer rich observation capabilities for visual navigation and 3D scene reconstruction; however, the resulting feature redundancy often compromises computational efficiency. This challenge is particularly pronounced during bundle adjustment, where the non-linear optimization of both system poses and scene points incurs substantial computational overhead. To address this challenge, this paper introduces a pose-only geometric constraint for multi-camera systems and proposes a corresponding pose adjustment algorithm. Specifically, we use generalized camera model to establish a unified representation of the multi-camera system. Building upon this model, we formulate the multi-camera pose-only constraint, which implicitly represents a 3D scene point using two base observations and their associated poses, thereby achieving a pose-only representation of the projection geometry. Subsequently, we introduce a multi-camera pose adjustment algorithm that eliminates 3D points from the parameter space, thereby achieving efficient and focused pose optimization. Experimental results on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms baseline bundle adjustment methods in computational efficiency, while maintaining or even improving pose estimation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多相机系统在视觉导航和3D重建中计算效率低的问题，提出了一种基于位姿几何约束的位姿调整算法。通过广义相机模型统一表示多相机系统，利用位姿约束隐式表示3D场景点，将3D点从参数空间中消除，从而在保持或提升位姿估计精度的同时显著提高计算效率。
AI.motivation: 多相机系统在视觉导航和3D场景重建中观测能力强，但特征冗余导致计算效率低，特别是在光束法平差（Bundle Adjustment）中，对系统位姿和场景点进行非线性优化计算开销很大。
AI.method: 1. 使用广义相机模型建立多相机系统的统一表示；2. 提出多相机位姿约束，利用两个基观测及其关联位姿隐式表示3D场景点，实现投影几何的位姿表示；3. 提出多相机位姿调整算法，将3D点从参数空间中消除，实现高效的位姿优化。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，所提算法在计算效率上优于基线光束法平差方法，同时维持或提升了位姿估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的位姿约束和位姿调整算法能有效解决多相机系统中特征冗余带来的计算效率问题，是一种高效且准确的位姿优化方案。

title: ZID-Net: Zero-Inference Diffusion Prior Decoupling Network for Single Image Dehazing
comment: Submitted to Neurocomputing. Includes 12 figures and 8 tables
summary: Single image dehazing is often constrained by a trade-off between restoration quality and computational efficiency. While efficient, CNN networks struggle to learn robust priors for dense and non-homogeneous haze. Conversely, diffusion models provide strong generative priors but suffer from severe inference latency and sampling instability. To address these limitations, we propose ZID-Net, a novel framework that explicitly decouples diffusion supervision from feed-forward inference. For efficient inference, we design a frequency-spatial decoupled feed-forward backbone. Within this backbone, a Channel-Spatial Laplacian Mask (CSLM) filters haze-amplified noise to extract purified structural details, while Lightweight Global Context Blocks (LGCBs) establish long-range spatial dependencies to capture the global variations of haze. A Dynamic Feature Arbitration Block (DFAB) then adaptively fuses these semantic and structural features for robust reconstruction. To provide this backbone with physical priors without the inference cost, we introduce a Zero-Inference Prior Propagation Head (ZI-PPH) during training. ZI-PPH leverages a conditional diffusion process to predict residual noise, providing degradation-aware structural supervision to the backbone. By discarding the diffusion branch at test time, ZID-Net integrates diffusion priors into a pure feed-forward architecture for accurate and efficient restoration. ZID-Net achieves 40.75 dB PSNR on the synthetic RESIDE dataset and outperforms existing methods with a 1.13 dB gain on real-world datasets. Additionally, it yields a 3.06 dB PSNR gain on the StateHaze1k remote sensing dataset with an inference time of just 19.35 ms. The project code is available at: https://github.com/XoomitLXH/ZID-Net.

AI.tldr: 提出ZID-Net框架，通过解耦扩散监督与前馈推理，在保持高效推理的同时引入扩散模型先验，在合成和真实去雾数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CNN去雾方法难以学习密集非均匀雾的鲁棒先验，而扩散模型推理延迟高且采样不稳定，两者存在恢复质量与计算效率的权衡。
AI.method: 设计频域-空域解耦的前馈骨干网络，包含CSLM滤除雾放大噪声、LGCB捕获全局依赖、DFAB自适应融合特征；训练时引入ZI-PPH通过条件扩散过程提供物理先验监督，推理时丢弃扩散分支。
AI.result: RESIDE合成数据集PSNR 40.75dB，真实数据集领先1.13dB，StateHaze1k遥感数据集提升3.06dB且推理仅19.35ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练阶段引入扩散先验、推理阶段保持纯前馈架构，有效平衡了去雾质量与计算效率，为图像复原提供新范式。

title: Caries DETR: Tooth Structure-aware Prior and Lesion-aware Dynamic Loss Refinement for DETR Based Caries Detection
summary: As dental caries appear as subtle, low-contrast lesions in intraoral imaging, existing deep learning models face significant challenges in the early detection of caries. While recent Transformer-based detectors have shown promising results in natural images, they often fail to capture the domain-specific anatomical priors crucial for dental caries detection. In this paper, we propose Caries-DETR, a specialized Transformer framework for caries detection in intraoral images. A Tooth Structure-aware Query Initialization (TSQI) is designed, leveraging large-scale intraoral photograph pre-training and a structure perception branch (SPB) to integrate high-frequency structural priors, guiding the model to focus on anatomically significant lesion areas. Furthermore, we design a Lesion-aware Dynamic Loss Refinement (LDLR) to implement quality-driven hard mining through adaptive loss reweighting based on lesion size, anatomical relevance, and prediction quality, optimizing detection for subtle lesions. Extensive experiments on two public datasets (i.e., AlphaDent and DentalAI) demonstrate that Caries-DETR achieves a state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods and exhibits good generalization and robustness. Code and data at https://github.com/XuefenLiu-SZU/Caries-DETR}{https://github.com/XuefenLiu-SZU/Caries-DETR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Caries-DETR，一种基于Transformer的牙科龋齿检测框架，通过牙齿结构感知查询初始化和病变感知动态损失优化，在口内影像中实现了优于现有方法的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型难以检测口内影像中低对比度的早期龋齿，而基于Transformer的检测器无法捕捉龋齿检测所需的领域特异性解剖先验知识。
AI.method: 1) Tooth Structure-aware Query Initialization (TSQI)：利用大规模口内照片预训练和结构感知分支（SPB）整合高频结构先验；2) Lesion-aware Dynamic Loss Refinement (LDLR)：基于病变大小、解剖相关性和预测质量的自适应损失重加权，实现质量驱动的难例挖掘。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集（AlphaDent和DentalAI）上，Caries-DETR达到了最先进水平，并展现出良好的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Caries-DETR通过引入牙齿解剖结构先验和动态损失优化，有效解决了早期龋齿检测难题，为口内影像分析提供了有效的专用框架。

title: Zoom In, Reason Out: Efficient Far-field Anomaly Detection in Expressway Surveillance Videos via Focused VLM Reasoning Guided by Bayesian Inference
summary: Expressway video anomaly detection is essential for safety management. However, identifying anomalies across diverse scenes remains challenging, particularly for far-field targets exhibiting subtle abnormal vehicle motions. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong semantic reasoning capabilities, processing global frames causes attention dilution for these far-field objects and incurs prohibitive computational costs. To address these issues, we propose VIBES, an asynchronous collaborative framework utilizing VLMs guided by Bayesian inference. Specifically, to overcome poor generalization across varying expressway environments, we introduce an online Bayesian inference module. This module continuously evaluates vehicle trajectories to dynamically update the probabilistic boundaries of normal driving behaviors, serving as an asynchronous trigger to precisely localize anomalies in space and time. Instead of processing the continuous video stream, the VLM processes only the localized visual regions indicated by the trigger. This targeted visual input prevents attention dilution and enables accurate semantic reasoning. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VIBES improves detection accuracy for far-field anomalies and reduces computational overhead, achieving high real-time efficiency and explainability while demonstrating generalization across diverse expressway conditions.

AI.tldr: VIBES是一个异步协同框架，利用贝叶斯推理引导的视觉-语言模型，通过在线贝叶斯推理模块动态更新正常驾驶行为的概率边界，仅触发VLM处理局部异常区域，从而高效准确地检测高速公路视频中的远场异常目标。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在跨场景泛化、远场小目标异常检测上效果差，且全局图像处理导致注意力稀释和计算开销过高。
AI.method: 提出VIBES框架，包含在线贝叶斯推理模块（动态更新正常驾驶行为概率边界，作为异步触发器定位异常）和VLM模块（仅处理触发器指定的局部区域，避免注意力稀释）。
AI.result: VIBES提高了远场异常检测精度，降低了计算开销，实现了高实时性和可解释性，并在多种高速公路场景下展现了良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VIBES通过贝叶斯引导的异步协同机制，有效解决了远场异常检测中的注意力稀释和计算成本问题，在准确性和效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: DynProto: Dynamic Prototype Evolution for Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: Recent studies show that using potential out-of-distribution (OOD) labels from large corpora as auxiliary information can improve OOD detection in vision-language models (VLMs). However, these methods often fail when real-world OOD samples fall outside the predefined OOD label set. To address this limitation, we propose DynProto, a novel approach that learns OOD prototypes dynamically during testing using only in-distribution (ID) information. DynProto is inspired by a key observation: OOD samples predicted as the same ID class tend to cluster in the feature space. With this insight, we leverage easy-to-detect OOD samples as ``anchors'' to find their harder-to-detect, similar counterparts.
